The PSDF is embedded into model predictive control by locally linearizing the stage-wise safety constraints within a sequential quadratic programming-based real-time iteration scheme, yielding the PSDF-embedded model predictive controller (PSDF-MPC). The design separates CPU/GPU computation so that the GPU evaluates batched PSDF values and gradients while the CPU solves a sparse quadratic program whose dimension is determined by system dimensions and horizon length, not by obstacle features. Microbenchmarks show that PSDF scales favorably against signed-distance query baselines. Closed-loop simulated and real-world navigation experiments, including comparisons with optimization-based baselines, demonstrate that PSDF-MPC maintains real-time feasibility and robust collision avoidance in dense polygonal environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多边形符号距离函数(PSDF)的几何精确碰撞避免约束，并将其嵌入模型预测控制(MPC)中。通过GPU批处理实现高效计算，在密集多边形障碍物环境中实现实时可行的鲁棒导航。
AI.motivation: 在障碍物密集环境中，优化-based局部规划与控制需要高频率的碰撞避免约束评估，计算负担沉重，成为控制循环的瓶颈。现有方法在计算效率与几何保真度之间难以兼得。
AI.method: 提出Polygonal Signed Distance Function (PSDF)——凸多边形机器人足迹与障碍物边界边之间的几何精确符号距离函数。采用无权重、无分支的张量化流水线，支持GPU批量执行和自动微分。将PSDF嵌入MPC，通过局部线性化阶段安全约束，在序列二次规划实时迭代方案中运行，形成PSDF-MPC。CPU/GPU分工：GPU评估批处理PSDF值及梯度，CPU求解稀疏二次规划。
AI.result: 微基准测试显示PSDF在符号距离查询方面优于基线方法。闭环仿真和真实世界导航实验（包括与优化-based基线的对比）表明PSDF-MPC在密集多边形环境中保持实时可行性和鲁棒碰撞避免。
AI.conclusion: PSDF-MPC通过几何精确且计算高效的碰撞约束设计，有效解决了密集障碍物环境中的实时控制瓶颈问题，可扩展性强（问题规模不随障碍物特征增长），为机器人局部规划提供了实用方案。

title: Biomechanics-aware Multi-view Markerless Motion Capture of Dexterous Hand Movements
summary: Markerless motion capture (MMC) techniques have been widely beneficial in biomechanical analysis of human movement; however, application to complex motions of the hand lags other musculoskeletal systems. The primary goal of this study was to evaluate the performance of a biomechanical reconstruction method that implements a gradient-based optimization approach with a biomechanical model in the loop for tracking dexterous, unconstrained hand movements using MMC. Using a custom, 8-camera setup, we acquired 121 video recordings from 6 participants performing 11 different tasks that spanned 6 hand postures, 5 object manipulation tasks, and involved motion of the proximal upper limb joints. Performance of the proposed MMC pipeline was directly compared to a more commonly adopted two-stage reconstruction method that first triangulates 2D keypoints from computer vision pose estimation algorithms to 3D and then enforces biomechanical constraints by solving a constrained inverse kinematics problem. Relative performance was assessed qualitatively by visual inspection and quantitatively using a computer vision metric. Our method generated solutions for all 121 video recordings; the two-stage method did not converge for 15% of the recordings. Across the remaining videos, our method produced more biomechanically plausible hand kinematics than the two-stage method and was more robust to occlusion effects during tasks that involved objects. The relative robustness of the end-to-end method suggests that it is more effective in utilizing the available 2D digital keypoint information. Automatic and biomechanically meaningful tracking of hand kinematics during dexterous movements has the potential to support clinical evaluation, rehabilitation monitoring, and studies of human motor control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于梯度优化的生物力学重建方法，用于无标记手部运动捕捉。相比传统的两阶段方法，该方法在121个视频记录中全部成功求解（两阶段方法15%失败），且生成的 kinematics 更符合生物力学原理，对遮挡更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 无标记运动捕捉（MMC）在人体运动生物力学分析中有广泛应用，但在复杂手部运动中的应用落后于其他肌肉骨骼系统。现有方法（先三角化2D关键点再施加生物力学约束的两阶段方法）存在收敛问题和遮挡鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出一种梯度优化的端到端生物力学重建方法，将生物力学模型嵌入优化循环中。使用8台定制相机，采集6名参与者执行11种任务（6种手部姿态、5种物体操作任务，涉及近端上肢关节运动）的121个视频记录。与传统两阶段重建方法（先2D关键点三角化到3D，再通过逆运动学施加生物力学约束）进行直接对比。
AI.result: 提出的方法对所有121个视频记录均成功生成解；两阶段方法在15%的记录上不收敛。在剩余视频中，本方法生成的手部运动学更符合生物力学特征，且对涉及物体的任务中的遮挡效应更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 端到端方法的相对鲁棒性表明其更有效地利用了可用的2D数字关键点信息。自动、生物力学有意义的手部运动学跟踪有望支持临床评估、康复监测和人类运动控制研究。

title: Server-side Anti-cheat in FPS games for Aimbot detection using Deep learning and Machine learning
summary: Modern video games are becoming more complex day by day. Most of these modern games are multiplayer first-person shooter (FPS) games. The rising popularity of FPS games emphasizes the need to combat cheating for fair and enjoyable gaming. As the number of players using cheating techniques like aimbots, wallhacks, and speed hacks is also increasing, we need a way to detect players who are using cheating tools to gain an unfair advantage over regular players. In this system, we focus exclusively on detecting aimbot cheats. Players who use aimbot cheats generally do not prioritize other aspects of the game. To distinguish between regular and cheating players, we identify specific features encompassing time-series data such as aim velocity, number of shots, distance to target, and more, along with behavioral data such as utility usage, player movement, and other gameplay patterns. Utilizing these features, we construct a server-side aimbot detection classifier named 'YAACS'. YAACS comprises a parser, a deep learning model, and intermediary connection utilities designed for integration with the game server. The proposed system achieves a classification accuracy of 88.6% with a false positive rate of 0.97% using a Stacked LSTM with Dense layers trained on sequences of 128 ticks (Tick Delta Negative=56, Tick Delta Positive=24), outperforming the Decision Tree baseline which achieves a higher accuracy of 96.2% but at a false positive rate of 2.68%, 2.76x worse than the best LSTM configuration. These results demonstrate that incorporating temporal context through sequence modelling is critical for minimising false accusations in FPS cheat detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出YAACS系统，利用Stacked LSTM模型分析时间序列和行为数据，在FPS游戏中检测自瞄作弊，准确率88.6%，误报率仅0.97%，相比决策树基线误报率降低2.76倍。
AI.motivation: 现代FPS游戏作弊现象严重，尤其是自瞄作弊（aimbot）破坏游戏公平性。现有检测方法误报率高，且缺乏对玩家行为时间序列特征的利用，需要一种低误报率的服务器端检测方案。
AI.method: 提出YAACS系统，包含解析器、深度学习模型和中间连接工具。提取时间序列特征（瞄准速度、射击次数、目标距离等）和行为特征（道具使用、玩家移动等）。使用Stacked LSTM+Dense层，在128个tick序列上训练分类器。
AI.result: Stacked LSTM配置在Tick Delta Negative=56、Positive=24时，分类准确率88.6%，误报率0.97%。对比决策树基线（准确率96.2%但误报率2.68%），LSTM误报率降低2.76倍。
AI.conclusion: 在FPS作弊检测中，引入时序上下文进行序列建模对降低误报率至关重要。虽然LSTM准确率略低于决策树，但其极低的误报率更适合实际部署，可减少对正常玩家的误判。

title: Agent-driven Long-tail Simulation for Autonomous Driving
summary: Evaluating autonomous driving systems in closed-loop settings requires realistic and interactive simulation, yet existing simulators largely rely on log replay or rule-based agents, limiting behavioral diversity and long-tail coverage. We propose an agent-driven simulation framework in which surrounding road participants are controlled by instruction-following large language models through a structured action interface, enabling intentional and reactive behaviors while preserving physical plausibility. Furthermore, we introduce SemanticPlan, a benchmark of closed-loop planning in long-tail and semantically rich scenarios that augment real nuPlan scenes with multiple interactive agents following diverse language instructions. Evaluation results show that state-of-the-art planners still struggle to consistently achieve safe and effective task completion, suggesting that these long-tail scenarios remain challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型驱动的仿真框架，通过结构化动作接口控制自动驾驶场景中的周边交通参与者，并构建了SemanticPlan基准来评估闭环规划器在长尾语义场景中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶闭环仿真器大多依赖日志回放或基于规则的智能体，导致行为多样性不足，难以覆盖长尾场景。
AI.method: 使用指令遵循的大语言模型通过结构化动作接口控制周围道路参与者，实现有意向且反应性的行为，同时保持物理合理性；并构建SemanticPlan基准，在真实nuPlan场景中增加多交互智能体和多样化语言指令。
AI.result: 当前最优规划器在长尾场景中仍难以持续实现安全且有效的任务完成。
AI.conclusion: 这些长尾语义场景对现有自动驾驶规划系统仍构成显著挑战。

title: Track the Noise, Move the World:3D-Grounded Motion-Consistent Noise for Controllable Video Generation
summary: Modern image-and-text-to-video diffusion models can synthesize highly realistic videos by iteratively denoising an initial Gaussian noise tensor conditioned on reference image and text inputs. However, existing approaches still lack precise and unified controllability over both object motion and camera motion within a single generation process. We present UniCaMo, a unified framework that enables simultaneous control of object trajectories and camera viewpoints by directly constructing the input noise of the diffusion model. Specifically, UniCaMo builds a shared 3D-grounded motion-consistent noise space across latent video frames. Sparse 3D point tracks are used to warp the Gaussian noise of the reference frame along desired object trajectories, while a virtual spherical noise representation provides globally consistent noise values for newly revealed scene regions under camera motion. By combining local track-guided noise warping with global sphere-based noise sampling, UniCaMo maintains geometric and temporal consistency under both object movement and viewpoint changes. Because UniCaMo modifies only the input noise, it requires no auxiliary adapters, control branches, or architectural changes to the underlying video diffusion model. With lightweight LoRA fine-tuning on large pretrained video diffusion models, including Wan 2.1 (14B), UniCaMo achieves state-of-the-art results in both video quality and motion controllability on standard controllable video generation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: UniCaMo提出统一框架，通过构造共享3D运动一致噪声空间，结合局部轨迹引导噪声扭曲和全局球面噪声采样，实现对视频扩散模型中物体运动与相机运动的联合控制，无需额外适配器或架构修改。
AI.motivation: 现有图像-文本到视频扩散模型虽能生成高质量视频，但缺乏对物体运动和相机运动的同时精确可控性，需要一个统一的控制框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建跨帧的3D运动一致噪声空间；2) 利用稀疏3D点轨迹扭曲参考帧高斯噪声以控制物体运动；3) 采用虚拟球面噪声表示为新场景区域提供全局一致噪声；4) 仅修改输入噪声，无需适配器或架构改动；5) 结合轻量LoRA微调预训练大模型。
AI.result: 在标准可控视频生成基准上，包括基于Wan 2.1 (14B)的微调，达到了视频质量和运动可控性的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: UniCaMo通过纯噪声空间操作实现了对物体轨迹和相机视角的联合控制，保持了时空一致性，且轻量高效。

title: Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B: Compressing Hybrid MoE LLMs
summary: We present Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B, a compressed variant of Nemotron-3-Super optimized for interactive deployment. We designed the model to maximize server throughput under high user throughput constraints. In interactive serving workloads on a single 8xB200 node, Puzzle-75B-A9B achieves approximately 2x higher server throughput than Nemotron-3-Super at matched user throughput constraints. In ultra-long-context deployment on a single H100 GPU, the compressed model increases 1M-token concurrency from 1 request to 8 requests. Puzzle-75B-A9B is constructed using a multi-stage pipeline that combines the Iterative Puzzle compression framework with knowledge distillation, reinforcement learning, quantization, and a Multi-Token Prediction head. The compression process jointly optimizes heterogeneous MoE pruning, active parameter budget, and Mamba pruning to improve inference efficiency while preserving model quality. We evaluate Puzzle-75B-A9B on a broad suite of reasoning, coding, multilingual, long-context, and agentic benchmarks. Despite substantial compression, the model retains strong downstream accuracy relative to the parent model across a wide range of tasks. These results demonstrate that large hybrid MoE models can be substantially optimized for deployment efficiency while maintaining strong downstream capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B，一种对Nemotron-3-Super进行压缩的变体，专为交互式部署优化。在8xB200节点上实现约2倍服务器吞吐量提升，在单H100 GPU上可将100万token并发从1提升到8。通过多阶段流水线（迭代拼图压缩、知识蒸馏、强化学习、量化、多token预测头）构建，联合优化异构MoE剪枝、活跃参数预算和Mamba剪枝，在保持模型质量的同时大幅提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 大型混合MoE模型在交互式部署场景中面临服务器吞吐量瓶颈和高用户并发下的性能挑战，需要在保持下游任务精度的同时显著压缩模型以提升部署效率。
AI.method: 采用多阶段压缩流水线，包括：1）迭代拼图压缩框架；2）知识蒸馏；3）强化学习；4）量化；5）多token预测头。联合优化异构MoE剪枝、活跃参数预算和Mamba剪枝三个维度。
AI.result: 在8xB200节点上，交互式服务吞吐量相比原模型提升约2倍；在单H100 GPU上，超长上下文部署的100万token并发从1提升到8；在推理、编码、多语言、长上下文和智能体基准测试中保持较强的下游精度。
AI.conclusion: 证明了大型混合MoE模型可以通过多阶段压缩流水线在保持强大下游能力的同时，显著优化部署效率，为实际交互式部署提供了可行方案。

title: A Perception-Manipulation Robotics System for Food Cutting
summary: In the development of cooking robots, mastering the task of cutting is crucial. A significant challenge lies in the diverse properties of food, which necessitate distinct cutting policies and even different knives for optimal processing. This paper presents a perception-manipulation framework for food-cutting tasks. Our system features a knife selection module that utilizes force data from a preliminary fixed trial cut to select the appropriate knife for the given food. This is followed by an adaptive cutting phase using reinforcement learning (RL) to balance cutting speed and energy efficiency. In our experiments, the knife selection module achieved 100% successful rate on unseen food, and we compared the performances of fixed policy, RL policy, with human operators. Our method not only achieves high performance but also demonstrates comparable results to those of human participants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向烹饪机器人的食物切割感知操作框架，包含基于力数据的刀具选择模块和基于强化学习的自适应切割策略，在实验中刀具选择成功率达100%，切割性能接近人类水平。
AI.motivation: 烹饪机器人中食物切割任务面临食材多样性带来的挑战，不同食材需要不同的切割策略甚至不同的刀具才能达到最佳处理效果，现有方法缺乏针对食材特性的自适应切割能力。
AI.method: 提出感知-操作两阶段框架：(1) 刀具选择模块：通过一次固定试切获取力数据，据此为给定食材选择合适刀具；(2) 自适应切割阶段：使用强化学习(RL)策略平衡切割速度与能量效率。
AI.result: 刀具选择模块在未见过的食材上达到100%的成功率；RL策略在切割性能上优于固定策略，并与人类操作者的表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效解决食材多样性带来的切割难题，通过力数据驱动的刀具选择与RL自适应切割，实现了接近人类水平的高性能切割，为烹饪机器人自动化切割任务提供了可行方案。

title: Conversational Human Audio-visual Talking Dialogue Generation
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 as a main paper
summary: Large-scale dyadic interactive audio-visual dialogue (DIAD) datasets provide fundamental data resources for developing humanoid interactive virtual agents and digital humans. However, collecting such data is time-consuming, expensive, and ethically sensitive. To address this, we propose CHAT, a new dyadic interactive audio-visual dialogue generation (DIADG) framework that generates diverse, paired, and mutually responsive speech-face dialogue clips from a single textual prompt. CHAT unifies large language models and talking face models with interactive audio and facial behaviour refinement modules, enabling the generation of aligned dyadic dialogue clips with diverse contents and facial identities. Experiments show that CHAT outperforms existing related methods designed for similar tasks under both objective and subjective evaluations. Moreover, our synthesised CHAT-AVD-50k dataset serves as effective pre-training data for downstream interactive head generation, consistently improving PerFRDiff and ReactDiff on REACT 2024. CHAT offers a scalable alternative to the costly and ethically sensitive collection of real dyadic interaction data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHAT框架，可从单文本提示生成多样化的双人交互视听对话片段，解决了大规模交互对话数据收集成本高、耗时且涉及伦理问题等挑战。CHAT统一了大语言模型和说话人脸模型，并引入交互式音频与面部行为精炼模块，生成内容多样、身份各异且对齐的双人对话片段。实验表明CHAT在客观与主观评估上均优于现有方法，且合成的CHAT-AVD-50k数据集作为预训练数据能有效提升下游交互式头部生成任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模双人交互视听对话数据集是开发类人交互式虚拟智能体和数字人的基础资源，但收集此类数据耗时、昂贵且涉及伦理敏感问题。现有方法缺乏从单一文本提示生成完整双人交互对话的能力，因此作者希望提出一种可扩展的替代方案来生成高质量的双人交互对话数据。
AI.method: 提出CHAT框架，将大语言模型与说话人脸模型统一，结合交互式音频与面部行为精炼模块。从单一文本提示出发，生成内容多样、身份各异且相互对齐的双人对话视频片段，包括语音和面部动作的同步生成。
AI.result: 客观与主观评估中CHAT均优于现有同类方法。合成的CHAT-AVD-50k数据集作为预训练数据，能显著提升PerFRDiff和ReactDiff在REACT 2024挑战赛上的下游交互式头部生成性能。
AI.conclusion: CHAT提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，避免了真实双人交互数据收集的高成本与伦理敏感问题，为交互式虚拟智能体和数字人的开发提供了有效的数据生成工具。

title: Decentralized Aggregation of LLM Predictions via Wagering Mechanisms
summary: It is increasingly common to aggregate predictions from multiple LLMs, each with domain expertise or access to private tools and data, to improve collective prediction performance. In decentralized settings, aggregation weights need to be determined without access to models' private information and should remain robust to strategic reporting. We propose a family of advantage-aligned wagering mechanisms for LLM aggregation (WALLA), in which each model reports a prediction and a learned wager, and predictions are aggregated using wagers as weights. WALLA introduces a leave-one-out baseline into the net payout function, yielding three desirable properties: (1) dominant-strategy incentive compatibility of prediction under arbitrary belief structure, (2) advantage--wager alignment, where the optimal wager is proportional to the model's expected score advantage, and (3) prediction-agnostic wager optimization, enabling decentralized learning of wager policies without requiring optimal predictions. We further instantiate two mechanism variants that trade off normality and no-arbitrage while maintaining a bounded worst-case deficit for the mechanism. Experiments on question-answering and forecasting benchmarks across heterogeneous models and private-information settings show that WALLA matches centralized aggregation methods in predictive performance, while simultaneously achieving decentralized learning, advantage-aligned aggregation weights, uncertainty awareness, and incentive-compatible prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出WALLA机制，通过让多个LLM报告预测和可学习的赌注权重，实现去中心化、激励兼容的聚合，无需访问模型私有信息。
AI.motivation: 在多LLM聚合的场景中，去中心化环境下需要确定聚合权重，但不能访问模型的私有信息，且要对策略性报告具有鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出WALLA（优势对齐的赌注机制），每个模型报告预测值和可学习赌注，以赌注作为权重进行加权聚合；引入留一法基线到净收益函数中，实现三个理想性质。
AI.result: 在问答和预测基准实验中，WALLA在预测性能上与集中式聚合方法相当，同时实现了去中心化学习、优势对齐的聚合权重、不确定性感知和激励兼容的预测。
AI.conclusion: WALLA成功实现了去中心化环境下多LLM聚合的激励兼容性与性能保障的统一，为不需要信任中介的LLM协作提供了可行方案。

title: SurgAM: Surgical Affordance Map Prediction with Multimodal Feature Fusion for Robot Autonomy
summary: Surgical automation is being increasingly studied, yet bridging visual scene understanding with autonomous action planning remains a fundamental challenge. While much research effort has been made on scene perception (e.g., tool recognition and scene segmentation), understanding and predicting actionable possibilities for surgical automation is still underexplored. In this paper, we introduce surgical affordance prediction, which identifies actionable regions for fundamental surgical actions from visual data. Specifically, a novel adaptive feature fusion framework is proposed that leverages the complementary strengths of a self-supervised vision transformer encoder for its superior semantic understanding and a large-scale generative model encoder for its spatially-aware capability. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical prompt learning mechanism to adapt to varying procedural contexts. Finally, a scene-guided attention decoder is proposed to focus on critical surgical areas while suppressing background distractions. To validate the effectiveness, we established a new dataset, derived from publicly available surgical datasets with affordance annotations for three basic surgical actions: aspiration, clipping, and retraction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance. Moreover, we validate our framework's applicability for downstream automation on a realistic lung and prostate phantom, and results show that the predicted affordance maps successfully enable autonomous surgical actions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出手术可供性预测（surgical affordance prediction）框架，利用自监督ViT与大模型编码器的自适应特征融合，结合层次化提示学习与场景引导注意力解码器，从视觉数据中识别手术动作可行区域，在公开数据集上实现SOTA性能，并在真实体模上验证了自主手术的可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有手术自动化研究多聚焦于场景感知（如工具识别、分割），但理解和预测手术动作的可执行区域这一关键环节仍未被充分探索，缺乏从视觉到自主行动规划的桥梁。
AI.method: 提出自适应特征融合框架，融合自监督ViT编码器（语义理解）与大模型生成编码器（空间感知）；引入层次化提示学习以适应不同手术流程上下文；设计场景引导注意力解码器聚焦关键区域、抑制背景噪声。
AI.result: 在包含抽吸、夹闭、牵拉三种基本手术动作可供性标注的公开数据集上达到SOTA性能；在肺部和前列腺体模上验证了预测的可供性图能够成功驱动自主手术动作。
AI.conclusion: 手术可供性预测是连接视觉感知与自主动作规划的有效桥梁，所提框架在准确性和下游任务适用性上均表现优异，为手术自动化提供了新思路。

title: Prior Bias in Vision Language Models on UML Diagram Interpretation
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to software engineering artifacts, especially UML class diagrams whose meaning depends on visual notation. Yet, it is unclear whether VLMs actually read such diagrams or instead answer from pretrained priors about how classes typically relate. We introduce a controlled UML benchmark in which each prior-conforming diagram is paired with its prior-conflicting counterpart that (1) preserves the same class names and layout while (2) reverses only the relation arrow. We evaluate eight open-source VLMs from two model families, InternVL3.5 and Qwen3, alongside two closed-source frontier models GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 Mini. Across the eight open-source models, reversing the arrow reduces relation-direction accuracy by 33.48% on average, while GPT-5.4 Mini retains a 10% gap. In the harder three-class condition, accuracy drops sharply by 45.28% for open-source models, and even 18.62% for the GPT-5.4 family on average. Scaling provides only limited improvements and is family-dependent. Our benchmark presents a diagnostic prior-driven failure in diagram-grounded software understanding. Our artifact is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UMLKnowledgeConflict-8461.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个 UML 类图基准测试，通过反转箭头方向来检验 VLM 是否真的理解图示关系，发现模型严重依赖先验知识，箭头反转导致关系方向准确率大幅下降（开源模型平均下降33.48%），且模型规模扩大带来的改进有限。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在软件工程图表上的表现令人困惑：它们是否真正理解 UML 类图的视觉符号意义，还是仅依赖从预训练数据中习得的关于类之间典型关系的先验知识？需要一种方法来区分这两种能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个受控 UML 基准测试，每个符合先验的图表都配对一个违反先验的版本——保留相同的类名和布局，仅反转关系箭头方向。评估了8个开源VLM（InternVL3.5和Qwen3系列）和2个闭源前沿模型（GPT-5.4和GPT-5.4 Mini）。
AI.result: 箭头反转导致开源模型关系方向准确率平均下降33.48%，GPT-5.4 Mini 仍存在10%的差距。在更难的三类条件下，开源模型准确率骤降45.28%，GPT-5.4 系列平均下降18.62%。模型规模扩大带来的改进有限且依赖于模型家族。
AI.conclusion: 该基准测试揭示了 VLM 在图表接地软件理解中存在一种诊断性的先验驱动失败模式——模型很大程度上是在"猜测"而非真正"阅读"图表语义，这对将 VLM 应用于软件工程任务提出了警示。

title: MechMath Agent Team: LLM Driven Agents for Mathematical Research
summary: AI reasoning has become a central focus in contemporary artificial intelligence, largely driven by the success of large language models. However, mathematical research, which is characterized by non-linear derivation paths, rigorous logical requirements, and protracted exploration cycles, poses severe challenges for existing reasoning systems. To overcome these limitations, we present the MechMath Agent Team (MMAT), which is a large language model driven agent designed to serve as a co-pilot throughout the full cycle of mathematical research. We design a tripartite Harness Architecture that decouples system responsibilities into Control, Execution, and Augmentation planes, thereby reconciling rigorous logical control with the agility demanded by open-ended research. Building upon this framework, we instantiate three specialized agents: a Knowledge Base Manager, a Natural Language Prover, and a Formal Language Prover, all operating in a closed loop to produce formally certified mathematical proofs. We evaluate MMAT on open problems in Number Theory, Algebraic Complexity Theory, Differential Algebra, Operator Algebra, and Inequalities. Across a two-month deployment, 11 problems have been solved, demonstrating its capacity to act as a co-pilot throughout the entire research cycle. The contributions are threefold: a general decoupled Harness Architecture for multi-agent mathematical reasoning, its concrete instantiation in the MMAT system, and empirical validation on a diverse suite of open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MechMath Agent Team (MMAT)，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，采用三平面解耦架构（控制、执行、增强），通过知识库管理器、自然语言证明器和形式语言证明器三个专用智能体的闭环协作，在数论、代数复杂性理论等多个数学领域成功解决了11个开放问题。
AI.motivation: 数学研究具有非线性推导路径、严格逻辑要求和漫长探索周期的特点，现有推理系统难以应对这些挑战。本文旨在开发一个能够贯穿数学研究全周期的AI合作系统。
AI.method: 设计了三平面Harness架构，将系统职责解耦为控制平面、执行平面和增强平面，在严格逻辑控制与开放研究灵活性之间取得平衡。基于此框架实例化了三个专用智能体：知识库管理器、自然语言证明器和形式语言证明器，它们以闭环方式协同工作，生成形式化验证的数学证明。
AI.result: 在数论、代数复杂性理论、微分代数、算子代数和不等式等领域的开放问题上进行了评估，经过两个月的部署，成功解决了11个问题。
AI.conclusion: 贡献有三：提出了通用的解耦Harness架构用于多智能体数学推理，具体实现了MMAT系统，并在多个开放问题上进行了实证验证，证明了其作为数学研究全周期合作系统的能力。

title: ACE-Brain-0.5: A Unified Embodied Foundational Model for Physical Agentic AI
summary: Embodied AI is moving from isolated perception or action modules toward physical agents that understand, plan under goals, act through robot bodies, monitor progress, and improve from experience. Existing systems address this loop only in parts: end-to-end policies generate actions but often lack spatial reasoning, planning, and execution assessment, while robot-agent systems orchestrate tools or specialists but do not learn a shared representation. This fragmentation limits general Physical Agentic AI. We present ACE-Brain-0.5, a unified embodied foundation model that organizes robot intelligence into five coupled functions: spatial perception, decision making, embodied interaction, self-monitoring, and self-improvement. Built on ACE-Brain-0, which established spatial intelligence as a shared scaffold across robot platforms, ACE-Brain-0.5 extends an understanding-centric model into a closed-loop foundation model. A single 8B backbone instantiates the first four functions: grounding objects and affordances, reasoning over 3D and egocentric spatial relations, decomposing instructions into subgoals, generating navigation and manipulation actions, and estimating progress for verification and recovery. To unify these capabilities without cross-task interference, we introduce SSR+, which extends Scaffold-Specialize-Reconcile with a Reactivate stage after task-vector merging. The fifth function, self-improvement, is realized by a companion framework that updates external execution state, including task schemas, spatial memory, and failure-recovery cases, from rollouts. Across fifteen benchmarks, ACE-Brain-0.5 improves over ACE-Brain-0 on 14 of 18 spatial perception and grounding benchmarks, achieves competitive navigation and manipulation performance, and provides strong progress estimation in ID and OOD settings. Together, these results mark an early step toward general Physical Agentic AI.

AI.tldr: ACE-Brain-0.5 是一个统一的具身基础模型，将机器人智能组织为空间感知、决策、交互、自我监控和自我改进五个耦合功能，基于单个8B骨干网络实现闭环的物理智能体，在15个基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有具身AI系统碎片化严重：端到端策略缺乏空间推理和执行评估，机器人代理系统则缺乏共享表示。这种碎片化限制了通用物理智能体AI的发展。
AI.method: 提出ACE-Brain-0.5，将机器人智能组织为五个耦合功能（空间感知、决策、交互、自我监控、自我改进），使用单个8B骨干网络同时实现前四个功能，并引入SSR+（在任务向量合并后增加Reactivate阶段）来统一各能力且避免跨任务干扰。第五个功能通过配套框架从rollouts中更新执行状态实现。
AI.result: 在15个基准测试中，ACE-Brain-0.5在18个空间感知和定位基准中的14个上超越ACE-Brain-0，实现了有竞争力的导航和操作性能，在ID和OOD场景下提供了强大的进度估计能力。
AI.conclusion: ACE-Brain-0.5标志着向通用物理智能体AI迈出的早期一步，证明了将感知、决策、交互、监控和改进统一到单一基础模型中的可行性。

title: Cancelable Biometric Template Protection Based on Multi-Instance Fusion: A Contralateral Iris Approach
summary: Biometric templates are vulnerable to theft if stored without protection. Unlike passwords, a compromised iris cannot be reissued. Although existing cancelable biometric schemes address this problem, most still require an external key or token, introducing an additional attack surface. This paper proposes a cancelable contralateral iris template protection scheme that eliminates the need for a separate token or stored secret, satisfying the three requirements of ISO/IEC 24745: irreversibility, unlinkability, and confidentiality. The method fuses three enrollment samples per eye using Majority Vote Fusion to produce a stable template, and applies a salt-based bit permutation derived from the subject's enrollment ID. Combining the left- and right-permuted templates via a bitwise XOR produces a single Protected Fused Template. Since left and right iris patterns are statistically independent, fusing contralateral irises improves the accuracy of the system. An attacker must possess both iris codes and both salts to recover any useful information, yielding a larger effective key space than single-iris schemes. Experiments on three datasets, CASIA-IrisV4-Interval, CASIA-IrisV2 (two devices), and CASIA-Iris-Thousand, yield EERs of $0.36$\%, $4.88$\%, $10.80$\%, and $3.35$\%, respectively; the highest value reflects the more challenging cross-device scenario. These results demonstrate that our contralateral approach outperforms unprotected baselines while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art cancelable methods. %In addition, an ablation study confirms the benefit on both recognition performance and security. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first scheme to combine tokenless multi-instance fusion and contralateral binding under ISO/IEC 24745.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需外部令牌的虹膜模板保护方案，通过融合双眼虹膜（对侧融合）并结合基于注册ID的盐值位排列与异或操作，满足ISO/IEC 24745标准的不可逆性、不可关联性和机密性要求，在多个数据集上取得了有竞争力的识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有可取消生物特征方案大多依赖外部密钥或令牌，引入了额外攻击面；且虹膜模板一旦泄露无法像密码一样重新签发，亟需一种无需额外存储秘密的保护方案。
AI.method: 1) 每只眼三份注册样本通过多数投票融合生成稳定模板；2) 基于注册ID的盐值对左右眼模板分别进行位排列；3) 将排列后的左右模板进行按位异或，生成单一受保护融合模板。利用左右虹膜统计独立的特性提升系统精度，攻击者需同时获得两个虹膜码和两个盐值才能恢复信息。
AI.result: 在CASIA-IrisV4-Interval、CASIA-IrisV2（两种设备）和CASIA-Iris-Thousand上分别取得EER为0.36%、4.88%、10.80%和3.35%，其中最高值对应跨设备场景。方案性能优于无保护基线，与现有可取消方法竞争力相当。
AI.conclusion: 该对侧虹膜融合方案是首个在ISO/IEC 24745框架下结合无令牌多实例融合与对侧绑定的方法，在安全性和识别精度上均表现出优势。

title: LLM-as-a-Tutor: Policy-Aware Prompt Adaptation for Non-Verifiable RL
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for non-verifiable instruction following increasingly relies on LLM judges with prompt-specific rubrics as reward signals. While recent methods adapt these rubrics to the evolving policy during training, the training prompts themselves remain static, drawn from fixed corpora. This static approach often results in a critical misalignment between prompt difficulty and policy capability, leaving the judge unable to recover a discriminative reward signal when prompts fail to elicit quality variance among rollouts. To address this misalignment, we introduce LLM-as-a-Tutor, a framework that extends the LLM's role from judge to tutor: a single model serves as an examiner that pairwise-compares policy rollouts to detect non-challenging prompts, and as a generator that appends atomic constraints to them. This append-only design monotonically raises difficulty in step with the policy's capability, producing a self-calibrating training signal without external difficulty schedules. On three complex instruction-following benchmarks, our method consistently outperforms both policy-unaware baselines and prior policy-adaptive methods that adapt rubrics or rewrite prompts, suggesting prompt adaptation as a missing axis of policy-awareness in non-verifiable RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-as-a-Tutor框架，将LLM从裁判扩展为导师角色，通过动态生成原子约束来适配提示难度与策略能力，解决非可验证指令跟随强化学习中静态提示导致的奖励信号判别性不足问题。
AI.motivation: 现有非可验证指令跟随的强化学习方法中，虽然奖励标准（rubrics）会随策略进化而调整，但训练提示本身来自固定语料库，导致提示难度与策略能力之间的错配，当提示无法引发rollout间的质量差异时，判别性奖励信号无法恢复。
AI.method: 提出LLM-as-a-Tutor框架，单一模型同时担任考官和生成器：考官通过配对比较策略rollout检测非挑战性提示，生成器为其追加原子约束。这种仅追加的设计单调提升难度，随策略能力自校准训练信号，无需外部难度调度。
AI.result: 在三个复杂的指令跟随基准测试中，该方法一致优于不考虑策略的基线和先前策略自适应方法（调整rubrics或重写提示），表明提示自适应是策略感知的非可验证RL中缺失的维度。
AI.conclusion: 提示自适应（prompt adaptation）是非可验证强化学习中一个被忽视但关键的策略感知维度，LLM-as-a-Tutor通过动态增加约束的方式有效解决了提示难度与策略能力的对齐问题。

title: RoboDojo: A Unified Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Comprehensive Evaluation of Generalist Robot Manipulation Policies
summary: Generalist robot manipulation policies have advanced rapidly, yet existing benchmarks remain limited in systematically evaluating their capabilities. Many rely on simple, short-horizon, or skill-narrow tasks with limited capability coverage, and are often conducted only in simulation or only in the real world. Simulation enables scalable feedback but misses physical deployment challenges, while real-world evaluation is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to reproduce. We introduce RoboDojo, a unified sim-and-real benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of generalist robot manipulation policies. RoboDojo includes 42 simulation tasks and 18 real-world tasks covering diverse and complementary manipulation capabilities. The simulation benchmark evaluates five dimensions: generalization, memory, precision, long-horizon execution, and open-vocabulary instruction following, while the real-world benchmark exposes policies to challenging physical-world deployment conditions. RoboDojo supports scalable evaluation through heterogeneous parallel simulation in Isaac Sim and provides RoboDojo-RealEval, a reproducible real-world evaluation system with remote cloud access, standardized hardware, scene reset, evaluation protocol, and deployment interface. Together with XPolicyLab, policies can be integrated once and evaluated across simulation and real-world settings with minimal adaptation. We integrate 30 policies into XPolicyLab and evaluate them on RoboDojo, establishing a public leaderboard and systematic analysis of current policy performance. The website is available at http://robodojo-benchmark.com/.

AI.tldr: RoboDojo是一个统一的仿真+真实世界机器人操控策略基准测试平台，包含42个仿真任务和18个真实世界任务，支持5个维度的评估（泛化、记忆、精度、长时程执行、开放词汇指令跟随），并提供了可复现的真实世界评估系统。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人操控策略基准测试存在局限性：任务简单、能力覆盖有限，且通常只在仿真或只在真实世界中进行评估。仿真的可扩展性好但缺乏物理部署挑战，真实世界评估成本高、耗时长且难以复现。因此需要一个统一的仿真-真实世界基准测试平台。
AI.method: 构建RoboDojo基准测试平台，包含42个仿真任务（覆盖泛化、记忆、精度、长时程执行、开放词汇指令跟随5个维度）和18个真实世界任务。仿真端使用Isaac Sim支持异构并行仿真，真实端提供RoboDojo-RealEval系统（远程云访问、标准化硬件、场景重置、评估协议和部署接口）。同时集成XPolicyLab，使30种策略只需一次集成即可在仿真和真实环境中评估。
AI.result: 成功集成30种策略到XPolicyLab并在RoboDojo上评估，建立了公开排行榜和系统的性能分析。
AI.conclusion: RoboDojo提供了全面的、可扩展的、可复现的机器人操控策略评估方案，填补了现有基准测试在仿真-真实世界统一评估方面的空白。

title: E-TraMamba: A New Paradigm for Efficient Long-Term 3D Feature Tracking with Event Cameras
summary: Event-based 3D tracking enables low-latency and high-speed perception, while existing CNN- and Transformer-based trackers struggle to capture long-range spatiotemporal dependencies in sparse, noisy event streams, especially under real-time and efficiency constraints. To address these challenges, we present E-TraMamba, the first Mamba-based framework for 3D feature tracking on event data. This new framework adopts a linear state-space model for efficient long-range modeling and integrates a lightweight affine-transform predictor to maintain stable tracking under motion blur and occlusion. We also design an effective scheme to fuse multi-scale cues -- local spatiotemporal patches, correlation maps, and positional embeddings -- into a unified representation that enables stable and smooth 3D tracking. We construct a large-scale synthetic dataset, named EvD-PointOdyssey, which is generated with monocular rendering and provides synchronized event streams, depth maps, and accurate 3D trajectories for training and evaluating event-based 3D tracking models. Extensive experiments on event-based benchmarks demonstrate that E-TraMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering over $2\times$ longer feature lifetimes under strict accuracy thresholds (e.g., 0.1 m), with higher tracked-feature ratios and lower RMSE than all baselines. These results make E-TraMamba a strong candidate for low-latency visual odometry, real-time SLAM, and interactive robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出E-TraMamba，首个基于Mamba的3D事件特征追踪框架，利用线性状态空间模型实现长程建模，结合多尺度融合和轻量预测器，在事件数据上实现高精度、低延迟的3D追踪，性能大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有CNN和Transformer追踪器难以在稀疏、有噪声的事件流中高效捕获长程时空依赖关系，且在实时性和效率约束下表现不佳。
AI.method: 采用Mamba（线性状态空间模型）进行高效长程建模；设计轻量仿射变换预测器以应对运动模糊和遮挡；设计多尺度融合方案（局部时空块、相关图、位置编码）得到统一表征；构建大规模合成数据集EvD-PointOdyssey用于训练评估。
AI.result: 在事件基准测试上达到SOTA，严格精度阈值（0.1m）下特征寿命延长2倍以上，追踪特征比率更高，RMSE更低。
AI.conclusion: E-TraMamba是低延迟视觉里程计、实时SLAM和交互式机器人领域的强有力候选方案。

title: Agent Step Value: State-Transition Measurement with State-Grounded LLM Evaluators
summary: Most agent evaluations collapse a multi-step trace into a final answer, a success flag, or a trajectory-level score. These aggregates obscure the diagnostic question developers need most: which action changed the state in a useful direction? We introduce Agent Step Value (ASV), a state-transition measurement framework that scores each observed action by the change it induces in a state-grounded evaluator's distribution over fixed candidate outcomes. ASV renders redacted before/after state projections, uses a stateless LLM evaluator to assign candidate log scores, and reports both gold-free belief diagnostics and offline oracle validation metrics. A label-free rationale pass separates evaluator deliberation from one-token option scoring, preserving candidate likelihoods while exposing leakage and floor-score events. On 100 reviewed open-QA evidence-seeking tasks with live PubMed retrieval, a partially live DeepSeek actor, and DeepSeek log-probability scoring, ASV evaluates 1,100 steps and 2,200 states. Under the fixed-layout rationale-conditioned protocol, mean gold-margin gain is -2.335 (trajectory-bootstrap 95\% CI [-3.395, -1.272]), entropy movement is 0.000, and mean Bayesian surprise is 2.693. ASV therefore localizes constructive and destructive belief pivots that final-answer scores and entropy-only step metrics miss. We release the standalone ASV Eval toolkit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent Step Value (ASV)框架，通过状态转换测量每个智能体行动对候选结果的信念影响，弥补了传统聚合指标（如最终答案、成功率）无法定位关键步骤的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评估方法将多步轨迹压缩为最终答案或成功率等聚合指标，导致开发者难以诊断"哪个动作在哪个方向上改变了状态"这一关键问题。
AI.method: ASV框架对每个观测到的动作，通过状态评估器的分布变化来评分；采用无标签的理由传递机制分离评估者推理与单token选项评分；使用红acted状态投影和离线oracle验证。
AI.result: 在100个开放QA证据搜索任务中，评估了1100步和2200个状态。平均黄金边际增益为-2.335（95% CI [-3.395, -1.272]），熵变化为0.000，平均贝叶斯惊奇为2.693。
AI.conclusion: ASV能够定位最终答案分数和纯熵指标遗漏的"建设性"与"破坏性"信念转折点，发布了独立的ASV Eval工具包。

title: Robustness Verification of an Autonomous Underwater Vehicle-based Plankton Classifier
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, Accepted in IEEE OES AUV Symposium 2026
summary:
The assessment of planktonic standing stocks and microorganism structures is critical for understanding upper ocean biological processes. Currently, autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) equipped with in-situ optical imaging and artificial intelligence (AI) methods offer a promising solution for persistent surveillance, mapping and monitoring of planktonic life. However, current AI methods often lack robustness in dynamic, unstructured environments, where environmental noise and non-biological artifacts lead to frequent misclassifications. Standard convolutional neural network (CNN) classifiers often struggle with such conditions, leading to misclassifications that require time-consuming manual validation by marine biologists.
  To address this issue, we propose a novel robustness verification framework for in-situ plankton classifiers based on reachability analysis. We also introduce a continuous-time neural ordinary differential equation (neural ODE) classification model leveraging the high-resolution imaging capabilities of the SilCam particle imager. In this paper, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework by formally verifying the robustness of the neural ODE model against environmental perturbations. We demonstrate that our verification framework acts as an automated filter providing formal guarantees of model stability against ambiguous data, thereby improving the reliability of autonomous sampling and reducing the post-processing workload.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于可达性分析的鲁棒性验证框架，结合神经ODE分类模型，用于提高AUV原位浮游生物分类器在动态环境中的可靠性，减少人工验证负担。
AI.motivation: 现有AI方法在动态非结构化环境中缺乏鲁棒性，环境噪声和非生物伪影导致频繁误分类，需要海洋生物学家耗时的人工验证，自动化水平受限。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于可达性分析的鲁棒性验证框架；2) 引入基于神经ODE的连续时间分类模型；3) 结合SilCam高分辨率成像仪进行数据采集。
AI.result: 该框架能够对神经ODE模型在环境扰动下的鲁棒性进行形式化验证，作为自动化过滤器提供模型稳定性的形式化保证，减少后处理工作量。
AI.conclusion: 本工作的验证框架能有效提升自主采样的可靠性，降低对模糊数据的误分类风险，为海洋原位浮游生物监测提供了更可靠的AI解决方案。

title: SPLIT: Training-Free AI-Generated and Partially Edited Video Detection via Spatial Patch-Level Incoherence and Temporal Roughness
summary: Deploying AI-generated video detectors in real-world services demands an ultra-low false positive rate (FPR) on real videos to avoid falsely rejecting authentic content, a regime where standard metrics such as AUROC fail to reflect actual operating behavior. We introduce Spatial Patch-Level Incoherence and Temporal Roughness (SPLIT), a training-free detector that operates on patch tokens from a frozen vision encoder to detect both fully generated and partially edited videos. SPLIT computes two complementary signals: Two-step Temporal Roughness (TTR), capturing non-smooth patch trajectories via one-step and two-step feature variation contrast, and Local Spatial Motion Incoherence (LSMI), measuring spatially inconsistent temporal changes through gradients of a feature-space motion field. The two are fused multiplicatively with gamma correction to sharpen real-fake separation at strict thresholds. We further propose a service-aligned evaluation protocol based on Fake Recall at fixed FPR with real-only threshold calibration and cross-real threshold transfer. Across three benchmarks (FakeParts, GenVideo, and ViF-Bench), SPLIT achieves the highest Fake Recall at FPR = $0.1\%$, substantially outperforming supervised and training-free baselines while remaining robust to post-processing with negligible overhead. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/mldljyh/SPLIT .

AI.tldr: SPLIT是一种无需训练的AI生成视频检测器，通过双信号融合（TTR+LSMI）在极低假阳性率下实现最优检测性能，并提出了面向实际服务的评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器在极低假阳性率（如0.1%）下表现不佳，AUROC等标准指标无法反映实际部署场景中的真实行为，且对部分编辑视频的检测能力有限。
AI.method: 提出SPLIT检测器，包含两个互补信号：1) Two-step Temporal Roughness (TTR) 通过一步和两步特征变化对比捕捉非平滑的patch轨迹；2) Local Spatial Motion Incoherence (LSMI) 通过特征空间运动场的梯度测量空间不一致的时间变化。两者通过Gamma校正进行乘法融合以增强真假分离。采用基于Fake Recall at fixed FPR的服务对齐评估协议。
AI.result: 在FakeParts、GenVideo和ViF-Bench三个基准上，SPLIT在FPR=0.1%时达到最高Fake Recall，显著优于监督方法和无训练基线方法，且对后处理具有鲁棒性，计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: SPLIT是一种高效、训练-free的AI视频检测方案，通过空间-时间双信号融合在极低假阳性率场景下表现出色，适用于实际服务部署。

title: ResearchStudio-Idea: An Evidence-Grounded Research-Ideation Skill Suite from ML Conference Outcomes
summary: Large language models have made research ideation increasingly accessible, yet effective idea development requires more than generating candidate directions. Researchers must ground a problem in current literature, identify meaningful bottlenecks, differentiate from existing solutions, and evaluate risks before committing to implementation. We present ResearchStudio-Idea as a reusable skill suite for this first mile of research ideation. The suite includes Paper-Search, a standalone multi-source literature search skill; Scoop-Check, a standalone prior-art collision checker for novelty claims; and IdeaSpark, the end-to-end skill that composes evidence grounding, pattern-guided generation, collision retrieval, audit, and idea-card rendering into one workflow. IdeaSpark is constructed from a corpus of 1,947 machine learning conference papers collected from ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS between 2021 and 2025, including Oral papers, a separately tracked high-citation subset, and rejected submissions. Analysis of these outcomes reveals 31 recurring ideation sub-patterns, consolidated into 15 reusable ideation patterns. Each pattern is operationalized as a structured card containing research contexts, bottleneck types, differentiation strategies, supporting precedents, and common failure modes. Given a research problem and an evidence bundle, IdeaSpark evaluates evidence readiness, reconstructs the surrounding research context, identifies unresolved bottlenecks, selects relevant patterns, instantiates one candidate direction, retrieves potentially conflicting prior work, and performs outcome-informed auditing. This workflow transforms reusable ideation patterns into traceable research proposals. Blind automated-judge evaluations show that IdeaSpark consistently produces stronger research proposals than no-skill and generic-skill baselines while maintaining competitive novelty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ResearchStudio-Idea，一个包含Paper-Search、Scoop-Check和IdeaSpark三个模块的可复用技能套件，用于学术研究思路的早期开发。基于1947篇机器学习会议论文分析出31个子模式并归纳为15个可复用模式，通过结构化卡片形式呈现。IdeaSpark将证据验证、模式引导生成、碰撞检测、审计和思路卡片渲染整合为完整工作流，自动评估显示其生成的研究提案优于无技能和通用技能基线，且保持竞争力新颖性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽使研究思路生成变得容易，但有效的研究思路开发需要将问题锚定在现有文献中、识别有意义的瓶颈、与现有解决方案区分、并评估风险。现有方法缺乏系统化的早期思路开发流程。
AI.method: 构建了包含Paper-Search（多源文献搜索）、Scoop-Check（新颖性碰撞检测）和IdeaSpark（端到端思路生成）三个模块的技能套件。基于1947篇ML会议论文分析出31个子模式并归纳为15个可复用模式，每个模式以结构化卡片（研究背景、瓶颈类型、区分策略、支持先例、常见失败模式）形式操作化。IdeaSpark工作流包括证据评估、研究上下文重构、瓶颈识别、模式选择、候选方向实例化、冲突文献检索和结果审计。
AI.result: 盲审自动化评估显示，IdeaSpark生成的研究提案一致性地优于无技能和通用技能基线，同时保持具有竞争力的新颖性。
AI.conclusion: 该套件将可复用的思路模式转化为可追踪的研究提案，有效支持研究早期阶段的系统化思路开发。

title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
comment: 23 pages, 24 figures, 4 tables. Preprint. Project page: https://srl-ethz.github.io/Mask2Real-WM/
summary: Action-conditioned world models allow robots to predict the future consequences of candidate actions without additional physical interaction, supporting policy evaluation, planning, and data augmentation. We present Mask2Real-WM, a two-stage action-conditioned world model for dexterous manipulation that decouples pixel prediction into a dynamics model and a rendering model. The dynamics model predicts future segmentation masks from past masks and 23-DoF action sequences. The rendering model maps the predicted masks to photorealistic RGB using a ControlNet-augmented Stable Video Diffusion backbone. The smaller sim-to-real gap in segmentation space enables the dynamics model to benefit from large-scale pretraining on over 50 h of synthetic simulation data, followed by fine-tuning on fewer than 2.5 h of real demonstrations. Experiments on a dexterous pick-and-place benchmark show that mask conditioning and simulation pretraining are both required for per-DoF action controllability across all 23 degrees of freedom. In contrast, monolithic baselines capture broad hand and end-effector trajectories but do not reliably reflect fine-grained, per-joint action effects.

AI.tldr: Mask2Real-WM是一种两阶段动作条件世界模型，将像素预测解耦为动力学模型（预测未来分割掩码）和渲染模型（将掩码映射为逼真RGB图像），通过在分割空间利用50+小时合成数据预训练和<2.5小时真实数据微调，实现了对23自由度灵巧操作的精确每关节动作控制。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件世界模型在灵巧操作中难以精确控制每个自由度（DoF）的细粒度动作效果，需要一种能够解耦像素预测并利用合成数据预训练的方法来提升控制的精准度。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 动力学模型从过去掩码和23-DoF动作序列预测未来分割掩码；(2) 渲染模型利用ControlNet增强的Stable Video Diffusion将掩码映射为逼真RGB图像。在50+小时合成数据上预训练，再在<2.5小时真实数据上微调。
AI.result: 在灵巧抓取-放置基准上，掩码条件化和仿真预训练对于23个自由度的逐关节动作可控性都是必需的；而整体式基线仅能捕捉粗略的手部和末端执行器轨迹，无法可靠反映细粒度的逐关节动作效果。
AI.conclusion: 将像素预测解耦为分割空间动力学模型和渲染模型，结合大规模仿真预训练，能够显著提升灵巧操作中细粒度动作控制的可控性和准确性。

title: ProLaViT: Learning Progressive Latent Visual Thoughts in Structured Latent Space
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress but still struggle with complex visual reasoning tasks requiring multi-step perception and logical deduction. While explicit visual generation incurs prohibitive computational costs, existing latent approaches often rely on external experts or lack rigorous cognitive logic. In this paper, we introduce ProLaViT (Progressive Latent Visual Thought), a framework empowering MLLMs to perform structured visual derivation in the continuous latent space. Unlike works dependent on heterogeneous external models, ProLaViT leverages an endogenous self-distillation mechanism, utilizing the model's own visual encoder to supervise latent thoughts. To facilitate this, we construct a scalable programmatic synthesis pipeline enabling the model to internalize algorithmic precision without inference time tools. We design two reasoning paradigms: (1) Coarse-to-Fine Causal Chain for spatial tasks, guiding attention from global context to local targets. (2) Dialectical Reasoning Chain for logical tasks, incorporating counter-factual thinking for verification. Furthermore, we propose a Distance-Weighted Diversity Loss to impose topology-aware constraints, preventing feature degeneration by enforcing semantic distinctiveness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ProLaViT outperforms baselines on vision-centric benchmarks, achieving superior accuracy and interpretability with high efficiency.

AI.tldr: ProLaViT让多模态大模型在连续潜空间中进行结构化视觉推理，通过自蒸馏机制、可编程数据合成、粗到细因果链和辩证推理链，以及距离加权多样性损失，在视觉推理任务上实现高效、准确且可解释的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型在复杂视觉推理任务中表现不足，需要多步感知和逻辑推理；显式视觉生成计算成本过高，而现有的潜空间方法依赖外部专家模型或缺乏严谨的认知逻辑。
AI.method: 提出ProLaViT框架：(1) 内生自蒸馏机制，用模型自身视觉编码器监督潜层思维；(2) 可编程合成数据流水线，让模型内化算法精度；(3) 两种推理范式：粗到细因果链（空间任务）和辩证推理链（逻辑任务，含反事实验证）；(4) 距离加权多样性损失，施加拓扑感知约束，防止特征退化。
AI.result: 在视觉中心基准测试中，ProLaViT优于基线方法，在准确率、可解释性和效率方面均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: ProLaViT通过潜空间中的结构化渐进推导，有效提升了MLLM在复杂视觉推理任务上的能力，同时保持高效性。

title: Why Pure Reasoning is Not Enough: Nature as the Source of Mathematical Innovation
summary:
We advance the hypothesis that human mathematical reasoning, constrained by both the undecidability and the computational intractability of even modest logical fragments, relies fundamentally on pattern matching from domains external to pure deduction. The most prolific reservoir of such patterns is the natural world, whose physical laws and biological systems have undergone billions of years of ``pre-computation'' and already exhibit surprisingly innovative solutions. To ground this claim, we trace the history of the Fourier transform and relevant mathematics, from the vibrating string controversy to the hear equation and subsequent formalisms prevalent in mathematics. At each critical juncture, a physics problem forced the acceptance or creation of a mathematical tool that pure formal reasoning failed to anticipate or, worse, human reasoning had resisted.
  We further survey the landscape of logical complexity, from NP-hard propositional satisfiability to the non-elementary decision-procedures for monadic second-order theories, to demonstrate that even when a logic is decidable, the resources required for worst-case deduction are astronomically prohibitive. We argue that these barriers make physics-inspired pattern matching not just a historical accident but a cognitive necessity. Finally, we draw the consequence for artificial intelligence: if pure reasoning is constitutively insufficient, then any system aiming at human-level mathematical creativity must embed a vast store of cross-domain patterns rather than rely on deduction alone. This furnishes a principled justification for the enormous scale of contemporary large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人类数学推理本质上依赖来自外部领域（尤其是自然界）的"模式匹配"，而非纯粹的演绎推理。作者以傅里叶变换的发展史为例，说明物理问题迫使数学接受纯形式推理无法预见甚至曾抗拒的工具。同时，逻辑复杂性的理论障碍（不可判定性、计算难解性）使得物理启发的模式匹配成为认知必然。最后，这一观点为当前大规模语言模型的巨大规模提供了原则性辩护。
AI.motivation: 作者希望挑战"数学完全基于纯粹逻辑演绎"的传统观点，论证人类数学能力在根本上依赖于从自然世界等外部领域获得的模式匹配。这一动机源于对逻辑系统固有局限（不可判定性、计算复杂性）的认识，以及对数学史中物理启发的关键作用的观察。
AI.method: 论文采用双重论证策略：(1) 历史案例分析——追溯傅里叶变换从弦振动问题到热方程的发展史，展示物理问题如何推动数学创新；(2) 理论分析——从NP难命题可满足性到单子二阶理论非初等决策程序，系统展示逻辑复杂性的层次，论证纯粹推理在认知上的不可行性。
AI.result: 论文论证了物理启发的模式匹配不是历史偶然，而是认知必然。即使在可判定的逻辑系统中，最坏情况下的演绎资源需求也达到了天文学级别的规模，这使得人类数学必然依赖"预计算"过的自然模式。由此推导出：任何追求人类级数学创造力的人工智能系统必须嵌入大量跨领域模式，而非仅依赖演绎推理。
AI.conclusion: 纯粹推理在认知上是不充分的；物理世界的"预计算"（数十亿年的自然演化）为数学提供了形式系统自身无法产生的创造性模式；这一见解为大语言模型的巨大规模提供了原则性辩护——海量跨领域训练数据本质上是对自然界"预计算"成果的人工模拟。

title: HUGS: Guiding Unified Dexterous Grasp Synthesis Across Modes and Scales via Learned Human Priors
comment: The first two authors contributed equally. Project website: https://hugs-dex.github.io/
summary: Dexterous grasping across diverse object scales requires contact modes ranging from two-finger pinches to bimanual grasps. Existing dexterous grasp synthesis methods reduce the high-dimensional optimization space with manually designed expected contacts and initialization heuristics, which struggle to balance synthesis success rate and diversity. We present HUGS (Human-prior-guided Unified Dexterous Grasp Synthesis), a human-prior-guided framework for unified dexterous grasp synthesis across modes and scales. Instead of directly retargeting human demonstrations, HUGS learns an object-conditioned human prior that captures human grasp preferences and guides downstream force-closure-aware optimization. The prior is trained on a compact self-collected human grasp dataset with 1.8K grasps over 304 objects, providing broad coverage of object scales and contact modes. During synthesis, HUGS adaptively proposes contact modes and wrist initializations, substantially improving the balance between contact-mode coverage and synthesis success rate over heuristic-based methods. With HUGS, we synthesize 3.2M robotic grasps over 157K scenes, spanning object half-diagonal lengths from 2 cm to 30 cm and modes from two-finger to bimanual grasps. Models trained on the synthesized dataset autonomously select appropriate contact modes in the real world, enabling grasping from screws to large boxes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HUGS框架，利用人类先验知识统一合成从两指捏取到双手抓握的多尺度灵巧抓取姿态，在覆盖广泛物体尺度和接触模式的同时提升了合成成功率，并生成了可用于训练真实世界抓取模型的大规模数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有灵巧抓取合成方法在处理多尺度物体时，高维优化空间依赖人工设计的期望接触点和初始化启发式策略，难以在合成成功率和多样性之间取得良好平衡。
AI.method: HUGS学习一个以物体为条件的人类先验模型，该模型捕捉人类抓取偏好，并指导下游基于力闭合的优化过程；同时自适应地提出接触模式和腕部初始化方案，替代传统启发式方法。
AI.result: 在304个物体上收集了1.8K人类抓取数据，合成3.2M机器人抓取姿态覆盖157K场景，物体尺寸范围从2cm到30cm，接触模式从两指到双手抓握。
AI.conclusion: HUGS在接触模式覆盖率和合成成功率之间取得了更好的平衡，训练出的模型能在真实世界中自主选择合适的接触模式，实现从螺丝钉到大箱子的多样化抓取。

title: Holo-Captioning: Toward the Text Equivalent of 3D Scenes
summary: This work introduces holo-captioning, a novel task that strives to seek the text equivalent of 3D scenes. As the initial step, we formulate holo-captioning as generating a structured textual description that comprehensively depicts all entities within a 3D scene -- including their semantic tags, spatial locations, attributes, and inter-entity relations. To tackle this challenging task, we first develop an effective captioning engine to produce detailed descriptions of individual entity instances and instance pairs, and contribute a large-scale benchmark comprising over 15K scenes for training and evaluation. Building upon this foundation, we propose HoloScribe, a novel model that features an instance-aware decoupled pipeline for generating structured holo-captions, and further incorporates anchor-aware instance linking to identify relational instance pairs. Additionally, we propose a comprehensive evaluation metric named HoloScore, and provide a human-curated test set to ensure reliable model assessment. Experimental results demonstrate that HoloScribe significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 3D dense captioners and 3D LLM generalists, underscoring the effectiveness of our approach. Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/holocap/

AI.tldr: 本文提出holo-captioning任务，旨在为3D场景生成结构化文本描述，涵盖实体语义标签、空间位置、属性及关系。为此构建了HoloScribe模型（含实例感知解耦管道和锚点实例链接）和含15K+场景的大规模基准，并提出HoloScore评估指标。实验表明HoloScribe显著优于现有3D密集字幕生成器和3D LLM通用模型。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景理解工作缺乏对场景中所有实体及其相互关系的全面文本描述，亟需一种能够生成结构化、细粒度3D场景文本描述的方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模基准（15K+场景）用于训练评估；2) 提出HoloScribe模型，包含实例感知解耦管道（为每个实体生成描述）和锚点实例链接机制（识别关系对）；3) 提出HoloScore综合评估指标及人工标注测试集。
AI.result: HoloScribe在多个维度上显著优于最先进的3D密集字幕生成器和3D LLM通用模型。
AI.conclusion: HoloScribe证明了实例感知解耦+锚点链接策略在结构化3D场景描述中的有效性，为3D场景理解提供了新范式。

title: Compressing the Validation Bottleneck: An Agentic Self-Driving Lab for Scientific Discovery
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop ; AI Scientist Competition
summary: Agentic AI-for-Science can automate ideation, planning, and analysis, but final validation still depends on real experiments. A self-driving lab (SDL) can execute those experiments, yet the loop still has bottlenecks: the agent may spend too many rounds on low-value experiments, or each round may require a high-cost experiment. We target these two physical bottlenecks with one agent. First, a prior-aware agentic DOE loop uses domain knowledge and past results to propose feasible and informative next experiments, reducing trials-to-target. Second, a cost-aware surrogate agent predicts high-cost, high-resolution measurements from low-cost, low-resolution measurements. It chooses between a high- and a low-cost measurement based on the predicted uncertainty. We examine these directions in the biology and materials domains, respectively. Together, under a single agent, these components aim to accelerate the SDL loop by reducing both the number of loops and the cost per experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一智能体框架，通过先验感知的DOE循环减少实验轮次、成本感知的代理模型降低单次实验成本，双管齐下加速自驱动实验室的物理瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室（SDL）中，智能体AI-for-Science虽能自动化构思、规划和分析，但最终验证仍依赖真实实验。现有流程存在两个物理瓶颈：智能体可能在低价值实验上浪费过多轮次，或每轮实验成本过高。本文旨在用单一智能体同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 1）先验感知的智能体DOE循环：利用领域知识和历史结果提出可行且信息量大的下一轮实验，减少达到目标所需的实验轮数。2）成本感知的代理模型：从低成本低分辨率测量预测高成本高分辨率测量结果，基于预测不确定性在高低成本测量之间做选择。分别在生物学和材料学领域验证这两个方向。
AI.result: 在生物学领域验证了先验感知DOE循环减少实验轮次的效果，在材料学领域验证了成本感知代理模型降低单次实验成本的效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过单一智能体同时减少实验轮次和单次实验成本，有望加速自驱动实验室的整体循环效率。

title: Simple-to-Complex Structured Demonstrations for Vision-Language-Action Learning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and robot action generation. Existing research has primarily focused on improving model architectures, training strategies, and dataset scale, while little attention has been paid to how demonstrations are collected and organized. We identify demonstration organization as a fundamental yet overlooked aspect of imitation learning, as it directly affects policy learning efficiency, training stability, and policy generalization. To address this gap, we propose a simple-to-complex structured demonstration collection strategy for VLA learning using a dual-arm robotic platform. Our approach systematically organizes data through three general principles: (i) decomposing complex manipulation tasks into progressively learnable sub-skills, (ii) standardizing the interaction environment to reduce unnecessary variability, and (iii) organizing demonstrations according to progressively increasing task complexity. This structured design enables VLA models to first acquire fundamental manipulation skills before learning increasingly complex task compositions, facilitating more effective learning of long-horizon manipulation tasks. We evaluate the proposed strategy on two representative robotic manipulation tasks: block grasping and sorting, and towel folding. Experimental results show consistent improvements in task success rate and training stability compared with the baseline method of directly collecting end-to-end complete task trajectories. These findings highlight demonstration organization as a previously underexplored but important factor in VLA learning and provide practical insights into efficient skill acquisition, scalable dataset construction, and long-horizon robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种简单到复杂的结构化演示收集策略，用于VLA模型学习，通过将复杂任务分解为可学习的子技能、标准化交互环境、按难度递增组织演示，显著提升了机器人操作任务的成功率和训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA研究主要关注模型架构、训练策略和数据集规模，忽视了演示数据的收集和组织方式。作者认为演示组织是模仿学习中一个被忽视但基础性的方面，直接影响策略学习效率、训练稳定性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出基于双臂机器人平台的简单到复杂结构化演示收集策略，包含三个原则：(1) 将复杂操作任务分解为渐进可学的子技能；(2) 标准化交互环境以减少不必要变化；(3) 按任务复杂度递增组织演示数据。使VLA模型先学习基础操作技能，再学习复杂任务组合。
AI.result: 在抓取排序和毛巾折叠两项任务上，相比直接收集端到端完整任务轨迹的基线方法，所提策略在任务成功率和训练稳定性上均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 演示组织是VLA学习中此前未被充分探索但重要的因素，为高效技能获取、可扩展数据集构建和长时程机器人操作提供了实用见解。

title: Learning Taxonomic Trees with Hierarchical Representation Regularization for Large Multimodal Models
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
summary: Taxonomies provide key information about the semantic relationships between concepts and the inherent organization of vision and language. Despite their impressive capabilities, large multimodal models (LMMs) often lack taxonomic knowledge, leading to low hierarchical visual recognition (HVR) consistency. These models typically only rely on language modeling objectives during fine-tuning and lack explicit taxonomy-aware regularization. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Representation Regularization ($HiR^2$), a simple plug-and-play regularizer that improves hierarchical consistency in LMMs. Specifically, we introduce a semantic-aware visual tree construction framework that extracts coarse-to-fine visual features from intermediate LLM layers guided by textual cues. The regularizer combines two complementary objectives: a taxonomic entailment loss that enforces hierarchy via hyperbolic entailment cones in the Lorentz model, and a discriminative dispersive loss that promotes angular separation of semantically similar embeddings on the unit sphere without disturbing the radial hierarchical structure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that $HiR^2$ effectively captures taxonomic structures across diverse LMMs and fine-tuning methods. Code is available at https://github.com/PKU-ICST-MIPL/HiR2_ICML2026.

AI.tldr: HiR²是一种即插即用的层次化表示正则化方法，通过语义感知的视觉树构建、双曲蕴含损失和判别性分散损失，提升大多模态模型在层次化视觉识别中的一致性和分类学知识。
AI.motivation: 大多模态模型虽然能力强大，但在分类学知识上存在不足，导致层次化视觉识别一致性低。现有微调方法仅依赖语言建模目标，缺乏明确的分类学感知正则化。
AI.method: 提出HiR²正则化器，包含：(1) 语义感知视觉树构建，从LLM中间层提取由粗到细的视觉特征；(2) 分类学蕴含损失，利用Lorentz模型中的双曲蕴含锥强制执行层次结构；(3) 判别性分散损失，在单位球面上促进语义相似嵌入的角分离，同时保留径向层次结构。
AI.result: 实验表明HiR²能有效捕获多种LMM和微调方法中的分类学结构，提升层次化视觉识别一致性。
AI.conclusion: HiR²是一种简单有效的即插即用正则化方法，解决了LMM在层次化视觉识别中分类学知识缺失的问题，具有良好的通用性和可迁移性。

title: VLA Grounder: Language-Conditioning Space Optimization for Black-Box VLA Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are commonly treated as end-to-end action policies conditioned on natural-language task descriptions. In practice, however, their behavior often depends sharply on how the instruction is phrased, suggesting that language is not merely a task label but an optimizable conditioning input. We study whether frozen VLA policies can be improved by optimizing language space rather than updating action weights. Our method introduces a language-conditioning space policy that translates a human instruction into a short VLA-grounded command using object appearance, spatial relations, and target-grounding cues. The language-conditioning space policy is initialized with a failure-derived command-space prior and optimized with reinforcement learning from sparse task-completion rewards, while the downstream VLA remains fully frozen. This yields language-conditioning space optimization: RL discovers which VLA-grounded commands best elicit successful behavior from the frozen action policy. Experiments on RL4VLA and VL-Think show that language-conditioning space optimization improves success on instruction-sensitive, symbolic, and multi-object manipulation tasks, demonstrating that language can serve as an optimizable variable for a robot foundation models. Website: https://tttonyalpha.github.io/vla_grounder

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言条件空间优化方法，通过强化学习优化VLA模型的文本指令输入（而非更新模型权重），使冻结的VLA策略通过更优的语言条件（如物体外观、空间关系等）在机器人操作任务中取得更高成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型常被当作端到端策略使用，但其行为对指令措辞高度敏感，这表明语言不仅是任务标签，更是可优化的条件输入。因此，作者研究是否可以在不更新动作权重的情况下，仅通过优化语言空间来提升冻结的VLA策略性能。
AI.method: 提出语言条件空间策略，将人类指令转化为由物体外观、空间关系和目标定位信息构成的VLA适配短命令。该策略先利用失败案例构建命令空间先验，再通过稀疏任务完成奖励进行强化学习优化，而下游VLA模型保持完全冻结。
AI.result: 在RL4VLA和VL-Think基准测试中，该方法在指令敏感、符号推理及多物体操作等任务上均显著提升了成功率，证明了仅优化语言空间即可改善冻结VLA策略的表现。
AI.conclusion: 语言可以作为机器人基础模型的可优化变量，通过优化语言条件空间而非模型权重，即可有效提升VLA策略在复杂操作任务中的性能。

title: SEAM: Smooth Execution of Action-Chunked Motion for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that execute fixed-length action chunks can exhibit multimodal bifurcation: a cross-chunk inconsistency in which adjacent chunks generated from independent Gaussian latents can converge to incompatible trajectory modes, producing abrupt discontinuities at chunk boundaries. Existing remedies either require backpropagation through the policy at each denoising step, rely on rejection sampling, or require retraining, each trading computational cost or task reliability for smoother transitions. We propose SEAM (Smooth Execution of Action-Chunked Motion), a training-free inference-time method for flow matching VLAs. SEAM exploits a simple synchronous-execution insight: after the robot consumes the executed prefix, the previous chunk's unexecuted tail is already available as an analytic consistency reference. Its core mechanism, Velocity-guided Loss Steering (VLS), derives a time-dependent target from this tail and applies a closed-form correction after each Euler step without backpropagating through the policy network. On LIBERO-10 with pi_0.5, SEAM reduces boundary jerk by 28%, reduces chunk transition discontinuity by 27%, preserves baseline-level task success, and keeps denoising-loop cost near the unguided baseline.

AI.tldr: SEAM是一种针对流匹配VLA策略的训练免费推理时方法，通过速度引导损失修正（VLS）在推理阶段消除动作块间的多模态分叉和不连续性，无需反向传播或重训练，显著降低边界冲击和过渡不连续性，同时保持任务成功率和计算成本。
AI.motivation: VLA策略执行固定长度动作块时存在多模态分叉问题——相邻块因独立高斯潜变量可能收敛到不兼容的轨迹模式，导致块边界出现突然不连续。现有解决方案（反向传播、拒绝采样、重训练）均需牺牲计算成本或任务可靠性。
AI.method: 提出SEAM方法，核心是速度引导损失修正（VLS）：利用机器人执行前缀后前一块未执行尾部作为一致性参考，从该尾部推导时变目标，在每个欧拉步后施加闭式修正，无需通过策略网络反向传播。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-10基准上使用pi_0.5，边界冲击降低28%，块间过渡不连续性降低27%，基础任务成功率保持不变，去噪循环成本接近未引导基线。
AI.conclusion: SEAM是一种高效、轻量级的推理时解决方案，在不增加训练负担和计算成本的前提下，有效解决了VLA动作块执行中的一致性问题。

title: See the Emotion: A Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling for EEG Emotion Recognition
summary: Despite the high accuracy of EEG-based emotion recognition, existing models remain opaque "black boxes", lacking semantic grounding between abstract neural features and human-interpretable states. In this paper, we reframe EEG explainability as a cross-modal generation task, shifting the paradigm from feature attribution to behavioral visualization. We introduce Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling, a novel framework that translates high-dimensional EEG signals into identity-anonymized facial emojis. Guided by the neuroscientific inspiration of neural-facial association, this approach grounds neural representations in the manifold of observable facial dynamics. Technically, our framework integrates FMENet, a specialized backbone modeling expression-relevant spatial synergies, and the Facial Emoji Learning Branch (FELB), which treats emoji reconstruction as a structured semantic regularizer. Extensive experiments on EAV and MMER benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among EEG-only models. Crucially, it generates semantically faithful facial animations that provide a transparent, privacy-preserving window into the brain's emotional evolution, effectively allowing users to "see the emotion" directly from neural signals. Code is available at https://github.com/xian-sh/SeeEmotion

AI.tldr: 提出Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling框架，将EEG情感识别从黑盒特征归因转变为跨模态生成任务，通过生成面部表情符号实现可解释的情感可视化，在EAV和MMER基准上达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG情感识别模型是"黑盒"，缺乏神经特征与人类可解释状态之间的语义对应关系，难以理解大脑情感活动的神经表征。
AI.method: 提出Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling框架，包含两个核心组件：FMENet（建模表情相关空间协同性的专用骨干网络）和Facial Emoji Learning Branch (FELB，将表情符号重建作为结构化语义正则化器），将高维EEG信号转化为去身份化的面部表情符号。
AI.result: 在EAV和MMER基准测试中，该方法的EEG-only模型达到了最先进的准确率，并能生成语义忠实的面部动画，提供透明、保护隐私的大脑情感演化窗口。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将EEG可解释性重新定义为跨模态生成任务，从特征归因转向行为可视化，让用户能够直接"看见"大脑中的情感信号。

title: Measuring Harness-Induced Belief Divergence in Multi-Step LLM Agents
summary: Software-agent benchmarks usually report whether an agent solves a task, but the agent reaches that outcome through a harness that controls what it sees, which actions it can take, which failures are repaired, which states are verified, and which evidence is logged. We show that this harness can change the agent's multi-step beliefs even when the task, environment, and base LLM are fixed. We introduce a belief-rollout diagnostic that elicits structured K-step trajectories over progress, risk, recoverability, constraints, failure mode, uncertainty, future success, repair cost, and next action under alternative harnesses. We define a cross-harness belief divergence and decompose it into an arrival term for immediate interface shifts and a growth term for horizon-dependent belief changes. On controlled coding tasks and public-benchmark stress tests, blocked actions, compressed repairs, selective verification, and cost-aware evidence pruning often preserve terminal success while changing the beliefs that drive later decisions. We further introduce BIWM, a no-training protocol that canonicalizes observations, logs censored branches, expands repair traces, records verification masks, executes risky branches in shadow, and aligns belief trajectories across harness views. The results suggest that harness design is an experimental variable in agent evaluation, not an implementation detail. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hik289/Harness-induce-bias.git.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示软件智能体评估中的"操纵框架"（harness）会改变智能体的多步信念，即使任务、环境和基础LLM固定不变。作者提出信念展开诊断、交叉框架信念散度等工具量化此偏差，并引入BIWM协议规范化框架设计。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准评测通常只报告任务是否成功，忽略了控制智能体观测、动作、修复、验证等行为的"操纵框架"对智能体决策信念的隐性影响。
AI.method: 提出信念展开诊断（belief-rollout diagnostic）获取结构化K步轨迹；定义交叉框架信念散度（cross-harness belief divergence），分解为到达项（arrival term）和增长项（growth term）；设计BIWM协议（规范化观测、记录删枝、扩展修复轨迹、记录验证掩码、影子执行高风险分支等）对齐不同框架下的信念轨迹。
AI.result: 在受控编码任务和公开基准压力测试中，屏蔽动作、压缩修复、选择性验证、代价感知证据剪枝等操作虽然常能保持最终任务成功，但显著改变了驱动后续决策的信念。
AI.conclusion: 框架设计不是实现细节，而是智能体评估中的实验变量，必须被显式控制和报告。

title: RoboVista: Evaluating Vision Language Models for Diverse Robot Applications
summary: Diverse applications for robotics, such as industry and agriculture, require robots to operate across various embodiments, changing visual conditions, and complex planning. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a promising foundation for general-purpose and interpretable robotic reasoning. Aligning VLMs with diverse robot applications requires a modular understanding of the individual decision components that underlie robotic behavior. Capturing such structure is challenging for conventional robot benchmarks that are primarily based on teleoperated, end-to-end datasets. We propose Robot Question Answering (RQA), a modular evaluation framework and RoboVista, a benchmark curated from real robotic systems, research papers, and expert annotations. RoboVista contains 474 Visual Question Answering (VQA) instances with human annotated reasoning and covers 39 unique task types in agricultural, industrial, domestic, surgical robotics, autonomous driving, and open robot datasets. Experiments on RoboVista show that state-of-the-art VLMs exhibit substantial gaps. Physical robot experiments suggest strong correlation between RoboVista performance and real-world task execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RQA模块化评估框架和RoboVista基准，用于评估VLM在机器人决策中的表现。RoboVista包含474个视觉问答实例，覆盖39种任务类型。实验表明最先进VLM存在显著差距，且RoboVista性能与现实任务执行强相关。
AI.motivation: 机器人应用（工业、农业等）需要能够适应不同形态、视觉条件和复杂规划的通用机器人。VLMs虽有潜力，但现有机器人基准主要基于遥操作端到端数据集，缺乏对机器人行为决策组件的模块化理解，难以对齐VLM与多样化机器人应用。
AI.method: 提出RQA（Robot Question Answering）模块化评估框架，并构建RoboVista基准，从真实机器人系统、研究论文和专家注释中收集474个VQA实例，涵盖农业、工业、家庭、手术机器人、自动驾驶等39种任务类型，包含人工标注的推理过程。
AI.result: 最先进的VLM在RoboVista上表现出显著差距；物理机器人实验表明RoboVista性能与现实任务执行存在强相关性。
AI.conclusion: RoboVista能有效评估VLM的机器人决策能力，其评估结果与真实机器人任务执行高度相关，为机器人领域的VLM对齐提供了有价值的模块化评估工具。

title: R3D: Quantitative 3D Spatial Reasoning for Egocentric Wearables
summary: Quantitative 3D spatial reasoning from egocentric RGB-D video is a critical capability for next-generation wearable assistants. Yet existing benchmarks do not reflect the challenges of handling (1) natural egocentric video, (2) posed RGB-D video inputs, and (3) challenging quantitative 3D spatial reasoning Q&A. To fill this gap, we introduce R3D-Bench (Reasoning in 3D), a benchmark of 3,033 quantitative spatial reasoning questions across 15 types -- spanning multiple-choice, distance-based, and volumetric reasoning questions -- built on top of 57 egocentric video sequences from Aria Digital Twin. To set a strong baseline on this dataset, we introduce R3D, a model-agnostic spatial tool-calling framework. In contrast to existing approaches that directly embed 3D information into the model's input representation, R3D constructs a 3D scene from video using segmentation and depth-lifted object representations. It provides this information to an LLM through eight composable spatial tools. On R3D-Bench, R3D with Qwen3-VL 235B achieves 73.5% mean relative accuracy, substantially outperforming the best depth-enabled baseline (CuTR+Tools, 61.9%) and the best RGB-only baseline (Gemini 3 Flash, 46.5%).

AI.tldr: 提出了R3D-Bench基准测试（3033个3D空间推理问题）和R3D模型框架，在自然第一人称视频的定量3D空间推理任务上，R3D+Qwen3-VL 235B达到73.5%准确率，远超现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法同时处理自然第一人称视频、带深度信息的RGB-D视频输入以及定量3D空间推理问答这三个挑战。
AI.method: 构建R3D-Bench基准（57个Aria Digital Twin第一人称视频序列，3033个问题，15种推理类型），提出R3D框架：通过分割和深度提升目标表示构建3D场景，再通过8个可组合空间工具将3D信息提供给LLM。
AI.result: R3D+Qwen3-VL 235B在R3D-Bench上达到73.5%平均相对准确率，优于CuTR+Tools（61.9%）和Gemini 3 Flash（46.5%）。
AI.conclusion: R3D-Bench填补了现有3D空间推理基准的空白，R3D工具调用框架展现了模型无关的优势，为可穿戴AI助手的发展提供了重要方向。

title: Heaviside Continuity of Rolling Coefficients for Eliminating Epistemic Entropy in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) generate fluent outputs that can be wrong. Unlike humans, who often exhibit cues when providing false information, LLMs produce errors that are difficult to detect because autoregressive decoding provides no mechanism for verifying intermediate reasoning before state progression. We introduce Heaviside Continuity of Rolling Coefficients (HCRC), a verification-first execution framework that reformulates inference as predicate-gated state transitions governed by a Heaviside Gate. HCRC combines model confidence with independent verification signals from a parallel worker architecture, allowing execution to advance only when predefined correctness predicates are satisfied. This prevents invalid intermediate states from propagating, reducing epistemic entropy without modifying the underlying model. We evaluate HCRC on software-engineering and reasoning tasks across thirteen proposers from four providers. On capable proposers, the gate reduces the false-completion rate (FCR) from 4--7% to 0% while remaining latency-competitive and, in some settings, faster than the unwrapped model. On weaker proposers, it converts false completions into honest halts instead of corrupting downstream state. Beyond benchmarking, HCRC has operated for months as the production control plane of an agentic coding environment, authorizing file mutations, verification-driven progress reporting, and memory compaction. These results establish HCRC as a general framework for verification-driven LLM execution, showing that reliable reasoning can be achieved through principled execution control rather than model scale alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HCRC框架，通过谓词门控的状态转换机制（Heaviside Gate）结合模型置信度与独立验证信号，在推理过程中阻止错误中间状态传播。在软件工程和推理任务上将错误完成率从4-7%降至0%，并在生产环境中运行数月，证明了通过执行控制而非模型规模实现可靠推理的可行性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在自回归解码过程中无法对中间推理步骤进行验证，导致错误难以被察觉和阻止，亟需一种能在执行过程中主动验证推理正确性的框架。
AI.method: 提出Heaviside Continuity of Rolling Coefficients (HCRC)，采用谓词门控（Heaviside Gate）控制状态转换，结合模型置信度与并行工作器架构提供的独立验证信号，仅在满足正确性谓词时才允许执行推进。
AI.result: 在来自4个供应商的13个提案者的软件工程和推理任务上，HCRC将强大提案者的错误完成率从4-7%降至0%，且延迟具有竞争力；在较弱提案者上将错误完成转化为诚实停止；在生产环境中作为代理编码控制平面运行数月。
AI.conclusion: HCRC作为一种通用的验证驱动执行框架，证明了通过原则性的执行控制而非单纯扩展模型规模即可实现可靠的LLM推理。

title: DIVO: Continuous-time DVL-Inertial-Visual Odometry for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles
summary: This paper presents a novel acoustic-visual-inertial odometry solution leveraging a continuous-time trajectory estimation framework for unmanned underwater vehicles. Underwater environments present unique challenges for visual localization and mapping, such as light attenuation, illumination variance, and the presence of particulate matter. This motivates the use of additional sensing modalities and a visual tracking pipeline that is robust to diverse subsea conditions. The proposed system is the first continuous-time trajectory estimation framework based on Gaussian processes to fuse asynchronous measurements from a Doppler velocity log, a stereo camera, and an inertial measurement unit. Additionally, a novel visual frontend is proposed, incorporating learning-based feature extraction and matching that is robust to the specific challenges that subsea environments present. The proposed framework enables seamless integration of additional sensor modalities in continuous-time and is adaptable to different environments without reconfiguration. The proposed system is extensively tested on real-world underwater inspection datasets, where it outperforms state-of-the-art visual-inertial and acoustic-visual-inertial SLAM algorithms in accuracy, robustness, and trajectory coverage. Notably, the proposed system outperforms the state-of-the-art despite only forming short-term visual data associations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于连续时间轨迹估计框架的声学-视觉-惯性水下组合里程计方案，融合多普勒测速仪、立体相机和惯性测量单元的异步测量数据，并采用基于学习的视觉前端应对水下环境挑战，在实际水下检测数据集上优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 水下环境存在光线衰减、照明变化和微粒干扰等挑战，使纯视觉定位困难，因此需要融合多种传感模态并构建对水下环境鲁棒的视觉跟踪流程。
AI.method: 首次提出基于高斯过程的连续时间轨迹估计框架，融合DVL、立体相机和IMU的异步测量；同时提出基于学习的视觉前端（特征提取与匹配），增强对水下环境的鲁棒性；系统支持传感器模态的灵活扩展且无需重配置。
AI.result: 在真实水下巡检数据集上进行了广泛测试，在精度、鲁棒性和轨迹覆盖范围方面均优于现有视觉-惯性和声学-视觉-惯性SLAM算法，且仅依赖短期视觉数据关联即达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的连续时间融合框架能有效整合多模态异步传感器数据，结合鲁棒的视觉前端，显著提升了水下自主定位的性能和适应性。

title: STAC: Selective Spatiotemporal Aggregation and Compression for Video Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Video reasoning segmentation demands pixel-accurate object tracking across hundreds of frames under complex natural language queries, producing dense spatiotemporal tokens whose quadratic self-attention cost makes long-video processing prohibitive. Existing methods address this through token compression, yet typically operate on encoder features lacking temporal context, constraining selection before content redundancy can be reliably assessed. Informed compression requires contextual awareness, but acquiring that awareness at full resolution incurs the same quadratic cost compression aims to reduce. State-space models resolve this constraint, as their linear recurrence selectively conditions each token on temporal context at $\mathcal{O}(T)$ cost, producing representations where content redundancy becomes assessable. Building on this, Selective SpatioTemporal Aggregation and Compression (STAC) enriches features via decoupled bidirectional spatial and causal temporal scanning, leveraging recurrence-derived redundancy for hierarchical compression with adaptive thresholds optimised with segmentation objective. STAC achieves 85% token reduction and 1.8$\times$ speedup while surpassing compression-free baselines on reasoning segmentation benchmarks in a zero-shot streaming-compatible setting. Code is available \href{https://github.com/MCG-NKU/nku-video}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAC方法，利用状态空间模型的线性递归特性实现上下文感知的token压缩，在视频推理分割任务中减少85%的token并提升1.8倍速度，同时零样本超越无压缩基线。
AI.motivation: 视频推理分割需处理数百帧的密集时空token，其二次方自注意力成本使长视频处理难以承受。现有token压缩方法缺乏时序上下文，在内容冗余可被可靠评估前就进行选择，而获取全分辨率上下文意识又面临同样的二次方成本问题。
AI.method: STAC利用状态空间模型的线性递归（O(T)复杂度），通过解耦的双向空间扫描和因果时序扫描为每个token提供时序上下文，基于递归导出的冗余度进行分层压缩，并使用分割目标优化的自适应阈值。
AI.result: 实现85%的token缩减和1.8倍加速，在零样本、流式兼容的设置下超越无压缩基线。
AI.conclusion: 状态空间模型提供的线性递归机制能有效解决视频token压缩中的上下文感知难题，兼顾效率与性能。

title: Detecting Answer-Driven Reasoning in LLM-Based Educational Tutors via Truncated Chain-of-Thought Auditing
summary: Large language model (LLM) tutors often produce fluent step-by-step explanations, but a correct and pedagogically formatted response does not guarantee that the answer was derived from the student-facing problem. In realistic tutoring systems, the model may also have access to teacher notes, answer keys, rubrics, or retrieved solution artifacts. We study whether such private answer information can make tutor explanations answer-driven: the final answer is behaviorally available before the written explanation has justified it. Using Truncated Reasoning AUC Evaluation (TRACE), which probes how early a chain-of-thought prefix can pass a verifier, we evaluate 1000 GSM8K test problems under three paired tutoring contexts: question-only, correct answer-key, and wrong answer-key. At fixed fractions of each generated explanation, we force the model to answer immediately and verify the response against the gold numeric answer. With Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, answer-key access raises median TRACE AUC from 0.375 to 0.900 and makes the gold answer available at the first 10% prefix in 997 of 1000 cases. The effect remains strong on the 746 examples where both question-only and answer-key explanations end with the correct answer. These results support truncated CoT auditing as a lightweight process-level diagnostic for answer-driven reasoning in math tutoring explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE方法，通过截断思维链前缀验证来检测大模型数学辅导解释中是否存在"答案驱动推理"（即模型在解释尚未给出理由时已可输出正确答案）。实验发现，当模型能访问私有答案信息时，其中位数TRACE AUC从0.375跃升至0.900，且997/1000的案例在仅10%前缀处即可通过验证器。
AI.motivation: 在真实辅导系统中，LLM可能访问教师笔记、答案键等私有信息，导致生成的解释看似正确合理，实则可能是"答案驱动"的——即模型在正式推理之前已经知道正确答案，而非真正基于问题逐步推导。现有评估多关注最终回答正确性，缺乏对推理过程真实性的诊断方法。
AI.method: 提出TRACE（Truncated Reasoning AUC Evaluation）方法：在模型生成思维链的不同截断比例（前缀）处强制模型立即回答，并用验证器检查该早期回答是否已匹配正确答案。计算AUC作为指标，AUC越高表明答案越早可得。在GSM8K的1000道题上设置三组对照：仅问题、正确答案键、错误答案键，使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct进行实验。
AI.result: (1) 答案键访问下中位数TRACE AUC从0.375升至0.900；(2) 997/1000例在10%前缀处已可获取正确答案；(3) 即使在746例"仅问题"和"正确答案键"都最终输出正确回答的样本中，该效应依然显著，表明最终正确性不能掩盖过程问题。
AI.conclusion: 截断CoT审计可作为轻量级的过程级诊断工具，有效检测数学辅导解释中的答案驱动推理，为构建更可信的教育AI系统提供评估手段。

title: SILO: Simulation-in-the-Loop Sim-to-Real Transfer for Multi-Stage Cable Routing
summary: Linear-deformable manipulation remains challenging due to the complex deformations of objects such as cables and ropes.
