We introduce $\textit{proxy-conditioned video generation}$, where a coarse proxy video from physics-based simulation or real-world recording serves as a dynamics carrier to control foreground object motion. Given a proxy video and a text prompt, the goal is to synthesize a new video that preserves the proxy dynamics while generating novel content and plausible interactions aligned with the prompt. Since paired proxy-target videos are difficult to obtain, we propose $\textbf{ProxyUp}$, a training-free framework built on pretrained video generative models. ProxyUp first inverts the proxy video into an intermediate latent representation and applies $\textbf{region-wise latent noising}$, preserving motion-critical proxy latents while injecting noise into regions intended for text-driven regeneration. To mitigate the distribution mismatch and weak foreground-background coupling introduced by this heuristic latent composition, we further propose $\textbf{Stochastic Flow Relaxation (SFR)}$, which progressively relaxes the composed latent toward the model's learned distribution before ODE sampling. Experiments on both simulation and real-world proxies show that ProxyUp outperforms strong video editing and motion transfer baselines in dynamic fidelity and text alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProxyUp，一种无需训练的视频生成框架，通过代理视频（如物理模拟或真实录制）控制前景物体运动，结合区域噪声注入和随机流松弛技术，在保持代理动态的同时生成符合文本提示的新内容。
AI.motivation: 文本提示难以精确描述复杂的物理运动和交互细节，现有视频生成模型对复杂动态的控制能力有限。
AI.method: 提出ProxyUp框架：1）将代理视频反演为中间潜表示；2）应用区域潜变量加噪（region-wise latent noising），保留运动关键区域、对文本驱动区域注入噪声；3）提出随机流松弛（Stochastic Flow Relaxation, SFR）缓解分布不匹配和前背景耦合弱的问题。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实代理视频上的实验表明，ProxyUp在动态保真度和文本对齐方面优于强视频编辑和运动迁移基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需配对数据的训练自由框架，通过代理条件控制视频生成，有效解决了复杂动态控制的挑战。

title: Self-Improving Diffusion Classifiers with Minority Preference Optimization
summary: Prior studies have demonstrated that diffusion classifiers achieve robust zero-shot classification performance. However, their effectiveness is strongly tied to the pretraining data distribution: they perform well in majority, high-density regions of the data manifold, but are significantly less accurate in minority, low-density regions. Although prior works on minority sampling have focused on generating more minority-like images, what minority sampling fundamentally enables beyond generation remains underexplored. In this paper, we reveal a direct relationship between minority sampling in generation and the perception capability of diffusion classifiers. Specifically, we show that enhancing minority sampling broadens the coverage of underrepresented regions on the data manifold, thereby improving diffusion-based recognition. To exploit this connection, we propose \textit{Self-Improving Diffusion Classifiers with Minority Preference Optimization} (MiPO), which fine-tunes a pretrained diffusion model using minority preference rewards. Using only arbitrary caption data, MiPO generates candidate samples, rewards those that better cover minority regions, and optimizes the model with LoRA and Group Relative Policy Optimization, without additional image data, external foundation models, or external reward models. This enables stable, prompt-adaptive minority sampling and translates low-density generative coverage into improved zero-shot diffusion classification. To sum up, we show that diffusion classifier perception is biased toward majority regions, demonstrate that this bias can be alleviated through minority preference optimization, and evaluate MiPO on five standard datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MiPO方法，通过少数类偏好优化微调扩散模型，增强低密度区域的生成覆盖，从而提升扩散分类器在零样本分类中的性能，尤其在少数类样本上的表现。
AI.motivation: 扩散分类器在密集区域表现良好，但在稀疏区域（少数类样本）准确率显著下降。现有工作仅关注生成更多少数类图像，而未探究少数类采样对分类感知能力的直接影响。
AI.method: 提出MiPO（自我改进扩散分类器的少数偏好优化），利用任意文本数据生成候选样本，通过少数偏好奖励筛选覆盖少数区域的样本，结合LoRA和Group Relative Policy Optimization微调扩散模型，无需额外图像数据或外部奖励模型。
AI.result: 在五个标准数据集上的实验表明，MiPO有效提升了扩散分类器在少数类（低密度区域）上的零样本分类性能，缓解了原有偏见。
AI.conclusion: 扩散分类器的感知存在向多数区域偏斜的问题，通过少数偏好优化可以有效缓解这一偏见，实现更均衡的分类表现。

title: Rethinking Depth Pruning for Vision Transformers: A Heterogeneity-Aware Perspective
summary: While prior studies have successfully compressed vision Transformers (ViTs) through various pruning techniques, most have concentrated on width pruning to achieve significant reductions in model size. Depth pruning, which removes entire layers from a ViT, is notoriously difficult for accuracy recovery despite its potential to deliver higher speedups, limiting the acceleration achieved by existing joint width-and-depth pruning methods. In this work, we reveal that the failure of existing depth pruning methods lies in their neglect of heterogeneity between different layers, and we introduce HetDPT, a heterogeneity-aware depth pruning method that avoids dimension mismatch. Comprehensive experiments on ImageNet-1K, CIFAR-100, COCO, and ADE20K validate our method: HetDPT achieves a 1.58$\times$ speedup for DeiT-B while maintaining accuracy and a 1.39$\times$ speedup for DeiT-S with nearly no accuracy degradation. Furthermore, when combined with width pruning, HetDPT+ sets a new state-of-the-art record in extreme ViT pruning, enhancing the acceleration ratio from 4.24$\times$ to 5.19$\times$ for the Isomorphic-Pruning-2.6G configuration while maintaining near-lossless accuracy; our code is available at https://github.com/Efficient-AI-for-All/HetDPT.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉Transformer（ViT）的深度剪枝难题，本文揭示了现有方法忽略层间异质性的缺陷，提出了异构性感知的深度剪枝方法HetDPT，实现了高效加速且精度无损。结合宽度剪枝的HetDPT+在极端剪枝场景下创下新纪录。
AI.motivation: 现有ViT剪枝工作多集中于宽度剪枝，深度剪枝虽能带来更高加速比，但精度恢复极具挑战。此前联合宽度-深度剪枝方法因忽略不同层之间的异质性，导致深度剪枝失败，限制了加速效果。
AI.method: 提出HetDPT（异构性感知深度剪枝方法），通过识别并利用ViT各层的异质性来避免维度不匹配问题，实现有效的深度剪枝。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K、CIFAR-100、COCO、ADE20K等数据集上验证：DeiT-B加速1.58×且精度不变；DeiT-S加速1.39×且几乎无损。与宽度剪枝结合的HetDPT+在极端剪枝中将加速比从4.24×提升至5.19×（Isomorphic-Pruning-2.6G配置），精度近乎无损。
AI.conclusion: 本文指出深度剪枝失败的关键在于忽略层间异质性，HetDPT有效解决了该问题。联合宽度剪枝的HetDPT+在极端ViT剪枝任务中达到新SOTA，代码已开源。

title: CineMobile: On-Device Image-to-Video Diffusion for Cinematic Camera Motion Generation
summary: The growing demand for image-to-video creation on mobile devices has increasingly focused on cinematic motion effects like bullet time, dolly zoom, slow motion, etc. While Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) exhibit strong performance in video generation, their large parameter sizes and multi-step iterative denoising processes lead to substantial computational overhead, making efficient generation on mobile devices challenging. We propose CineMobile to bridge the gap. In particular, CineMobile adopts a three-fold optimization strategy: (1) leveraging a distillation-guided pruning approach to derive a compact yet efficient model that retains the essential video generation capabilities required for cinematic effects; (2) optimizing the compressed model into a 4-step generator via a combination of diffusion distillation and reinforcement learning; (3) employing a hybrid post-training quantization strategy to compress the model footprint to under 1 GB. Experimental results show that compared to the teacher model with the Wan 2.1 architecture, CineMobile achieves a 40x speedup in generation while maintaining comparable visual quality. Specifically, CineMobile generates 49-frame 480p videos with a per-step denoising latency of 0.6s on an NVIDIA H200 GPU and 20s on the MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultimate 5G platform, with a peak memory usage of 1.8 GB, demonstrating its practical applicability for mobile-based image-to-video creation.

AI.tldr: CineMobile通过蒸馏引导剪枝、4步生成器优化和混合后训练量化三种策略，将图像转视频模型压缩至1GB以下，在移动设备上实现40倍加速，生成480p视频每步仅需0.6秒（H200 GPU）或20秒（移动平台）。
AI.motivation: 移动设备上的图像转视频生成需求日益增长（如子弹时间、慢动作等电影级效果），但现有Diffusion Transformer（DiT）参数量大且需多步迭代去噪，计算开销过高，难以在移动端高效部署。
AI.method: 三阶段优化策略：(1) 蒸馏引导剪枝，得到紧凑高效模型；(2) 结合扩散蒸馏与强化学习压缩为4步生成器；(3) 混合后训练量化将模型体积压缩至1GB以下。
AI.result: 相比Wan 2.1教师模型，CineMobile实现40倍加速，保持可比的视觉质量。生成49帧480p视频时，每步去噪延迟在H200 GPU上为0.6秒，在MediaTek Dimensity 8400平台上为20秒，峰值内存1.8GB。
AI.conclusion: CineMobile证明了移动端进行高质量图像转视频电影级效果生成的可行性，通过系统化的模型压缩与加速策略，在计算受限设备上实现了实用化的视频生成能力。

title: Exploring SAM Supervision for Fine-Grained UAV Target Segmentation under Data Scarcity
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) target segmentation remains challenging due to the small size of objects, appearance variations, cluttered backgrounds, and the scarcity of densely annotated data. These factors hinder the performance and practical deployment of lightweight segmentation models in real-world UAV applications. To address this problem, this paper investigates the use of SAM3 (Segment Anything Model 3) as a pseudo-label generator for training compact segmentation networks. Specifically, two supervision paradigms are explored: (i) direct pseudo-supervision using unaltered SAM3-generated masks, and (ii) a refinement strategy that re-applies SAM3 to localized image patches for improved mask quality. Based on these paradigms, a two-stage SAM3-guided pseudo-label generation framework is proposed. In the first stage, SAM3 generates coarse masks for initial object localization. The localized regions are subsequently cropped into patches and processed by SAM3 again to generate fine masks with accurate object boundaries and discard false positives. The resulting coarse and fine masks are then used as pseudo-labels to optimize a lightweight network, termed IPS-Seg, which consists of three components: an IdentityFormer backbone for feature extraction, an Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling module for multi-scale context aggregation, and a PixelShuffle-based decoder for spatial resolution recovery. Extensive experiments under multiple supervision settings demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The results show that IPS-Seg achieves a favorable trade-off between segmentation accuracy and computational efficiency while benefiting consistently from the proposed pseudo-label generation strategy. These findings highlight the potential of large-scale foundation models as annotation sources for training compact task-specific segmentation networks in low-label vision domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用SAM3作为伪标签生成器，通过两阶段框架（粗定位+细分割）生成高质量伪标签，训练轻量级分割网络IPS-Seg，在无人机目标分割任务中实现精度与效率的良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 无人机目标分割面临目标小、外观变化大、背景杂乱以及密集标注数据稀缺等挑战，导致轻量级分割模型性能受限且难以实际部署。
AI.method: 提出两阶段SAM3引导的伪标签生成框架：第一阶段用SAM3生成粗掩码进行目标定位；第二阶段裁剪局部区域重新输入SAM3生成精细掩码并去除误检。基于此训练轻量级网络IPS-Seg，包含IdentityFormer骨干、ASPP多尺度聚合和PixelShuffle解码器。
AI.result: 多种监督设置下的实验表明，IPS-Seg在分割精度和计算效率间取得良好权衡，且所提伪标签策略能持续提升模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 大规模基础模型可作为低标注视觉领域中紧凑任务特定分割网络的注释来源，具有显著潜力。

title: Q-TriM: Question-Guided Tri-Modal Attention for Audio-Visual Question Answering
summary: Audio-Visual Question Answering (AVQA) extends classical VQA by requiring joint reasoning over video and synchronized audio. However, many AVQA systems rely on deeply stacked layers of self- and cross attention across text, video, and audio. Such sequential stacking may incur loss of information such as subtle inter-modal cues over the layers, causing errors to accumulate across sequential attention layers during the fusion. We introduce Q-TriM which performs multi-modal fusion in a shallow and parallel manner instead of a deep and sequential manner. For Q-TriM, we propose a novel framework for attention operation incorporating video and audio conditioned on text. As a result, we obtain not only standard cross attention outputs but also Tri-Modal Attention representations in which Query, Key, and Value come from distinct modalities. These attention representations are combined in parallel at a single stage, thus avoiding the multi-modal fusion with deep stacks in order to mitigate error accumulation and depth-induced issues. Q-TriM achieves state-of-the-art performance on three AVQA benchmarks, including substantial gains on MUSIC-AVQA-R, which demonstrates its robustness and out-of-distribution generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/Sunghun95/Q-TriM

AI.tldr: Q-TriM提出了一种浅层并行的多模态融合方法，通过三模态注意力机制（QKV来自不同模态）替代传统的深层串行交叉注意力，在AVQA任务上取得SOTA效果，并展现出强大的分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统AVQA系统依赖深层堆叠的跨模态注意力层，这种串行融合会导致细粒度跨模态信息逐层丢失，错误累积。作者希望通过浅层并行融合来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 提出Q-TriM框架，设计三模态注意力机制（Query、Key、Value分别来自文本、视频、音频），在单阶段并行融合多模态信息，避免深层堆叠带来的误差累积。
AI.result: 在三个AVQA基准上达到SOTA性能，尤其在MUSIC-AVQA-R数据集上取得显著提升，验证了模型的鲁棒性和分布外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 浅层并行融合策略能有效替代深层串行融合，减少信息损失和误差累积，为多模态推理任务提供了新的设计范式。

title: GeoSAM-Lite: A Lightweight Foundation Model for Onboard Remote Sensing Segmentation
summary: The deployment of large-scale foundation models like Segment Anything Model (SAM) on resource-constrained Earth observation platforms is hindered by prohibitive computational costs and the domain shift between natural and remote sensing imagery. To address these challenges, we propose \textit{Geo}spatial \textit{S}egment \textit{A}nything \textit{M}odel-Lite (GeoSAM-Lite), a lightweight, prompt-free segmentation framework designed for efficient onboard remote sensing segmentation. GeoSAM-Lite incorporates two core innovations: (1) Geospatial-Domain Initialization (Geo-Init), a domain-aware pre-training strategy that distills geospatial priors from a specialized teacher to bridge the domain gap; and (2) Feature Fusion Layers (FFL), which recalibrate spatial features and restore high-frequency boundary cues to overcome the capacity bottlenecks of lightweight backbones. Experiments across representative datasets, with a primary focus on cloud scenarios to evaluate performance under extreme scale variations and complex boundaries, demonstrate that GeoSAM-Lite achieves competitive accuracy while reducing parameters by 92.8\% compared to the heavyweight RSAM-Seg. By establishing a superior Pareto frontier between efficiency and fidelity, GeoSAM-Lite offers a practical solution for real-time segmentation on edge devices.

AI.tldr: GeoSAM-Lite是一个轻量级、无需提示的遥感分割框架，通过Geo-Init领域感知预训练和FFL特征融合层，在减少92.8%参数量的同时保持竞争性精度，适合边缘设备实时分割。
AI.motivation: 大模型（如SAM）在资源受限的地球观测平台上部署面临计算成本过高和遥感与自然图像之间域偏移两大挑战，亟需轻量级高效解决方案。
AI.method: (1) Geo-Init：领域感知预训练，从专用教师模型蒸馏地理空间先验知识以弥合域差距；(2) FFL：特征融合层，重新校准空间特征并恢复高频边界线索，克服轻量级骨干网络的能力瓶颈。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上（重点聚焦云场景），GeoSAM-Lite在保持竞争性精度的同时，参数量相比RSAM-Seg减少92.8%，建立了效率与保真度之间的优越Pareto前沿。
AI.conclusion: GeoSAM-Lite为边缘设备上的实时分割提供了实用解决方案，在轻量化和高性能之间取得了有效平衡。

title: How Do Diffusion Classifiers Decide? A Bias-Centric Evaluation
summary: Diffusion models have recently been repurposed for zero-shot classification, giving rise to diffusion classifiers that identify the best-matching text prompt by minimizing the noise-prediction error. Despite their growing adoption, how these models make classification decisions remains poorly understood. We introduce ASOB-Bench, a bias evaluation for diffusion classifiers along three dimensions: Attribute binding, Size-Order bias, and Background dependency. These dimensions serve not as an exhaustive taxonomy but as targeted probes of how the text-conditioned reconstruction-error score reaches a decision. Such a perspective is well studied for discriminative vision-language models, yet remains overlooked for diffusion classifiers. Extending an existing framework with five new attribute categories on newly constructed datasets, we find diffusion classifiers are less prone to attribute misbinding than an OpenCLIP baseline; on the established ComCo benchmark they are substantially more susceptible to size-order shortcuts; and on ImageNet-B they suffer far larger accuracy drops, revealing heavy reliance on background over foreground cues. Reconstruction-error heatmaps and U-Net cross-attention visualizations expose the mechanism behind each bias. Because diffusion classifiers share the same denoiser as text-to-image models, these single-pass diagnostics also point toward analogous failure modes in generation. Overall, diffusion classifiers exhibit a distinct bias profile from vision-language models, offering guidance for building more robust diffusion-based models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASOB-Bench评估框架，系统分析了扩散分类器在属性绑定、大小顺序偏差和背景依赖三个维度上的偏见机制，发现其与视觉语言模型存在不同的偏见特征。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型被用于零样本分类（扩散分类器），但其决策机制尚不明确。已有对判别式视觉语言模型的偏见研究较为成熟，但对扩散分类器的偏见分析仍然缺失。
AI.method: 提出ASOB-Bench评估框架，沿属性绑定、大小顺序偏差、背景依赖三个维度构建新数据集；通过重建误差热图和U-Net交叉注意力图可视化揭示偏差机制；在五个新属性类别上与OpenCLIP等基线对比。
AI.result: 扩散分类器在属性绑定上优于OpenCLIP基线；在大小顺序偏差上显著更敏感；在背景依赖上准确性下降幅度更大，表明过度依赖背景而非前景线索。
AI.conclusion: 扩散分类器展现出与视觉语言模型不同的独特偏见特征，这些单次前向诊断也能揭示文生图模型的类似失败模式，为构建更鲁棒的扩散模型提供指导。

title: Sparse-View Surface Reconstruction using Gaussian Splatting through High-Confidence Depth Propagation with Normal Priors
summary: 3D reconstruction from sparse views is a challenging task in 3D computer vision. Recent studies on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable results with sparse views in novel view synthesis, yet reconstructing high-quality geometric surfaces from sparse views remains a challenge, due to the limited geometry clues and the discreteness of Gaussians. In this paper, we propose a novel 3DGS-based method for high-fidelity surface reconstruction from sparse views. Our key insight is to introduce a normal-guided depth propagation approach, which can extend depth information from high-confidence regions to constrain the depth in low-confidence areas. Additionally, we propose an abnormal depth edge-aware regularization to address depth discontinuities caused by the discreteness of Gaussians. Extensive experiments on DTU and Tanks-and-Temples datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in sparse view surface reconstruction. Project page: https://hanl2010.github.io/DP-GS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP-GS，一种基于3DGS的法线引导深度传播方法，用于从稀疏视图中重建高质量几何表面，通过引入法线引导的深度传播和异常深度边缘正则化，在DTU和Tanks-and-Temples数据集上达到SOTA水平。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏视图进行3D表面重建时，由于几何线索有限和高斯分布的离散性，传统3DGS难以生成高质量的几何表面。
AI.method: 提出法线引导的深度传播方法，将高置信区域的深度信息扩展到低置信区域；并设计异常深度边缘感知正则化，处理高斯离散性导致的深度不连续问题。
AI.result: 在DTU和Tanks-and-Temples数据集上，该方法在稀疏视图表面重建任务中超越了现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的DP-GS方法有效解决了稀疏视图下3DGS几何重建的难题，实现了高质量的表面重建。

title: When Simpler Is Better: Evaluating Translation Pipelines for Medieval Latin Manuscripts
summary: Despite remarkable progress in machine translation, Vision Language Models (VLMs) struggle on historical manuscripts, a domain that stresses core Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities: low-resource transliteration, archaic vocabulary, and noisy input signals. We present a systematic framework for evaluating the full image-to-translation pipeline on medieval Latin manuscripts, a setting in which scribal shorthand, ligatures, and parchment degradation expose failure modes that are invisible in clean-text benchmarks. Benchmarking on the CATMuS Latin dataset reveals a specialization gap: domain-specific Optical Character Recognition (OCR) models reduce character error rate by up to 4.3$\times$ compared to general-purpose VLMs, despite operating at orders of magnitude fewer parameters. We introduce the Interpres-Parallel-Corpus (IPC), a novel dataset comprising 1,383 aligned manuscript image lines, transcriptions, and expert translations, the first of its kind for medieval Latin. Our experiments uncover a complexity paradox: the simplest pipeline, a specialized OCR model feeding directly into a VLM, outperforms all multi-component variants. Adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or post-OCR correction introduces prompt saturation and error propagation that degrade aggregate translation quality. These findings offer both a new benchmark and practical guidance for deploying translation systems in low-resource historical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了中世纪拉丁文手稿的图像到翻译的全流程，发现专用OCR模型+视觉语言模型的简单pipeline优于复杂方案，并发布了首个中世纪拉丁文平行语料库（IPC）。
AI.motivation: 现有机器翻译和VLM在历史手稿（低资源转写、古词汇、噪声输入）上表现不佳，缺乏系统的图像到翻译全流程评估框架。
AI.method: 基于CATMuS拉丁文数据集进行基准测试，构建了1,383条对齐的手稿图像-转录-专家翻译的IPC数据集，对比了多种pipeline（专用OCR+VLM、RAG、后OCR校正等）的性能。
AI.result: 专用OCR模型的字符错误率比通用VLM低4.3倍；最简单的专用OCR+VLM pipeline优于所有多组件变体；RAG和后OCR校正会引入提示饱和与错误传播，降低翻译质量。
AI.conclusion: 在低资源历史文本场景下，简单pipeline比复杂方案更有效，研究成果为历史手稿翻译提供了新基准和实践指导。

title: City-Level 3D Surface Reconstruction with Viewpoint Orientation Partitioning and Scene Completion
summary: Multi-view 3D surface reconstruction is a longstanding challenge in computer vision. Although recent large-scale reconstruction methods based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieve impressive novel-view synthesis, producing high-quality surfaces over large scenes remains difficult, due to complex geometry, long optimization, and limited memory. In this paper, we propose a novel yet simple partitioning method to efficiently and faithfully reconstruct large-scale scene surfaces. Our key insight lies in a scene partitioning method based on viewpoint orientation. This partitioning approach ensures that views with similar orientations are jointly involved for more accurate depth estimations, leading to precise surface reconstructions and balanced computation on multiple GPUs in parallel. In addition, we propose a strategy to detect and repair missing regions in the initial point cloud caused by sparse viewpoints or insufficient textures, thereby further improving the geometric quality. Extensive experiments on the GauU-Scene, MatrixCity, and UrbanScene3D datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches in surface reconstruction for large-scale scenes. Project page: https://hanl2010.github.io/VOP-GS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于视角方向划分场景的3DGS方法（VOP-GS），通过并行计算和缺失区域修复策略，实现大规模场景的高质量表面重建。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS方法在大规模场景表面重建中存在几何复杂、优化时间长、内存受限等问题，难以同时保证高效和高质量。
AI.method: 提出基于视角方向（viewpoint orientation）的场景划分方法，使相似视角联合优化深度估计；采用多GPU并行计算；并设计缺失区域检测与修复策略，补全稀疏视角或弱纹理区域导致的点云空洞。
AI.result: 在GauU-Scene、MatrixCity、UrbanScene3D三个大规模数据集上，表面重建效果优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于视角方向的场景划分能有效提升大规模场景表面重建的精度与效率，并行计算和缺失修复进一步增强了几何质量。

title: GeoSelect: Spatial-Program Execution for Training-Free Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
summary: Referring remote sensing image segmentation isolates the object named by a natural-language expression in an aerial image. Existing training-free methods resolve the expression through implicit vision-language activations or region-text similarity, which gives weak control over the spatial, comparative, and ordinal relations that dominate aerial referring: they cannot represent constructions such as the largest ship or the second court from the left. We propose GeoSelect, a training-free pipeline that reframes referring as the execution of a typed spatial program. A frozen, text-only language model synthesises the expression into a small domain-specific language, a well-formedness checker accepts the program, and a deterministic executor runs it. The central abstraction is a single scored candidate set type under which every operator composes: continuous geometric fields realise position and proximity as dense pixel-level maps, while discrete set and order operators add the extremum, ordinal, counted-union, and relational constructions that fields alone cannot express. Because execution is explicit, every intermediate program, field, and ranking is inspectable, and a reliability ladder degrades any failing program to a field-only special case, so every expression returns an answer. GeoSelect attains 58.86 mIoU on RRSIS-D test and 55.27 mIoU on RISBench test, more than twice the best prior training-free method on RRSIS-D, with no referring supervision and on a single GPU. A controlled comparison with candidates and segmenter fixed attributes the gain to explicit execution, not the backbone; an oracle decomposition localises the residual gap to detection recall on RRSIS-D and selection on RISBench, and an exposure audit confirms robustness to pretraining leakage. Code will be released upon acceptance at the project page https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoSelect/.

AI.tldr: GeoSelect是一个无需训练的遥感图像指代分割框架，将自然语言指代表达式编译为类型化空间程序，通过确定性执行器显式处理空间、比较和序数关系（如"最大船只"或"左边第二个球场"），在RRSIS-D上达到58.86 mIoU，超越此前最优无训练方法两倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有无训练方法依赖隐式视觉-语言激活或区域-文本相似度，无法有效处理遥感指代中常见的空间、比较和序数关系（如"最大船只"、"左边第二个球场"），缺乏对这些复杂语义的显式控制能力。
AI.method: 提出GeoSelect，一个无需训练的三阶段流水线：(1)使用冻结的纯文本语言模型将自然语言表达编译为小型领域特定语言（DSL）程序；(2)通过良构性检查器验证程序的合法性；(3)确定性执行器运行程序。核心抽象是单一评分候选集类型，连续几何场实现位置和邻近度的像素级映射，离散集与序数算子处理极值、序数、计数并集和关系构造。可靠性阶梯机制确保任何表达式都能返回结果。
AI.result: RRSIS-D测试集上达到58.86 mIoU，RISBench测试集上达到55.27 mIoU，在RRSIS-D上是最优无训练方法的两倍以上（且无需任何指代监督，仅用单GPU）。消融实验将增益归因于显式执行而非骨干网络；Oracle分解定位残差缺口；曝光审计证实对预训练泄露具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GeoSelect通过将指代分割重构为类型化空间程序的执行，在无需训练的情况下显著超越了现有的无训练方法，验证了显式、可解释的推理路径对于复杂空间语义指代的有效性，且中间过程完全可审查。

title: G$^2$TAM: Geometry Grounded Track Anything Model
summary: Human spatial understanding arises from jointly perceiving geometry and semantics, enabling consistent object identification and localization across viewpoints and time. Current video segmentation models depend on explicit object appearance memory banks for instance tracking, yet they remain vulnerable to large viewpoint changes and long-term occlusions. Leveraging the spatial consistency afforded by modern feed-forward 3D reconstruction models, we propose the Geometry Grounded Tracking Anything Model (G$^2$TAM), a unified framework for promptable instance tracking in 3D using only unordered RGB images or videos. G$^2$TAM employs spatially aligned geometric representations as implicit memory, ensuring stable instance identity and localization across frames and views. At its core is a cross-modal spatial encoder that integrates visual and textual prompts into a shared geometric space, enabling end-to-end spatial reconstruction and instance-consistent mask prediction. To support training and evaluation, we construct InsTrack, a large-scale dataset with a dedicated validation split for benchmarking. Extensive experiments show that G$^2$TAM delivers strong cross-view consistency, promptable instance spatial tracking, video object segmentation and spatial reconstruction, establishing a foundation for interactive, geometry-grounded spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G²TAM，一种利用几何空间一致性实现3D中可提示实例跟踪的统一框架，通过空间对齐的几何表示作为隐式记忆，结合跨模态空间编码器，在无需显式外观记忆库的情况下实现跨视图和跨时间的稳定实例识别与定位，并在自建数据集InsTrack上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视频分割模型依赖显式物体外观记忆库进行实例跟踪，但在大视角变化和长期遮挡场景下表现脆弱，缺乏对几何与语义联合感知的空间一致性理解。
AI.method: 提出G²TAM框架，核心包括：1) 利用前馈3D重建模型的空间一致性，采用空间对齐的几何表示作为隐式记忆；2) 设计跨模态空间编码器，将视觉和文本提示集成到共享几何空间中；3) 实现端到端的空间重建和实例一致掩码预测。
AI.result: 在跨视图一致性、可提示实例空间跟踪、视频目标分割和空间重建等任务上均表现优异，构建的InsTrack数据集为评估提供了有力支撑。
AI.conclusion: G²TAM为交互式、基于几何的空间推理奠定了基础，证明了将几何空间一致性融入实例跟踪的有效性。

title: Full Glyph Images Beat Token Embeddings: A Controlled Study for Transformers
summary: Modern language models generally represent text as sequences of discrete token embeddings, an assumption deeply rooted in current practice but rarely questioned. We challenge this representation, especially for Chinese, by replacing index-based token embeddings entirely with a single rasterized image of the character sequence, processed by a vision encoder composed of a shared ResNet and a shallow Vision Transformer. To isolate the role of input representation, we construct a dual-branch controlled framework in which both a Vision-based model and an index-based baseline share an identical decoder backbone, training objective, optimizer, and data curriculum. Any performance difference is therefore attributable to the input modality only. Across all tested decoder backbones, the Vision-based model consistently outperforms the baseline, reaching a peak accuracy of 0.429 versus 0.355 for the index-based baseline,that is, a 21% relative improvement, while converging in about half the number of training epochs. The advantage emerges especially within the first five epochs (under 21% of total data) and persists under moderate character corruption: the corrupted Vision model matches the clean index-based baseline. Ablation studies reveal that the advantage requires both spatially coherent input and a ViT encoder with 2D positional encodings. A cross-script comparison on English shows the advantage does not transfer directly to alphabetic writing systems, suggesting that the uniform visual density and radical structure of Chinese characters are enabling conditions. These findings suggest that transformers are more modality-agnostic than commonly assumed, and that discrete tokenization is not a fundamental requirement for Chinese language modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建视觉输入（字符栅格化图像）与索引式token嵌入的严格对照实验，发现基于视觉的中文语言模型在性能上显著优于传统索引式基线（准确率提升21%），且收敛更快、对字符损坏更鲁棒。研究挑战了离散tokenization的必要性，并揭示了中文汉字（视觉密度均匀、部首结构）是这一优势的关键条件。
AI.motivation: 挑战语言模型将文本表示为离散token嵌入的默认假设，质疑这种表示方式（尤其针对中文）是否必要，探究用连续视觉输入替代索引式token嵌入的可能性。
AI.method: 构建双分支对照框架：视觉分支将字符序列栅格化为图像，经共享ResNet+浅层Vision Transformer编码；索引分支使用传统token嵌入。两分支共享相同的decoder骨干、训练目标、优化器和数据策略，确保性能差异仅源于输入模态。
AI.result: 视觉模型在所有测试骨干上一致优于索引基线，峰值准确率0.429 vs 0.355（相对提升21%），训练收敛速度约快一倍。优势在训练前5个epoch（不到21%数据）即显现，且在字符损坏场景下，受损视觉模型仍可匹配干净索引基线。消融实验表明优势需要空间连贯输入和2D位置编码的ViT。英文对照实验显示该优势不直接迁移到字母文字系统。
AI.conclusion: Transformer比普遍认为的更具模态无关性，离散tokenization并非中文语言建模的基本要求；汉字均匀的视觉密度和部首结构是视觉输入优势的使能条件。

title: InfraNet: Quality-Aware RGB Guidance for Efficient Infrared Object Detection
summary: Robust object detection under adverse visual conditions remains a long-standing challenge for multi-modal perception systems. Existing fusion-based methods typically require both RGB and infrared (IR) inputs, and treat them equally during both training and inference, which compromises their robustness when the RGB modality becomes unreliable or unavailable. In this case, we propose \textbf{InfraNet}, an IR-centric quality-aware framework that regulates RGB guidance during training and supports flexible RGB--IR or IR-only deployment. InfraNet employs an asymmetric architecture where the primary IR pathway extracts multi-scale infrared features for predictions, while the auxiliary RGB pathway provides reliability-controlled supervisory signals. The core of InfraNet is \textbf{QualGate}, a quality-aware fusion module that learns a task-oriented control signal to suppress unreliable RGB guidance and compensate IR features during cross-modal training. Built upon InfraNet, we design two architectural variants: a lightweight IR-only architecture InfraNet-IR and an RGB--IR architecture InfraNet-RGB-IR. Our method is evaluated through extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets (LLVIP, FLIR-Aligned, M$^3$FD, and DroneVehicle), showing strong or competitive accuracy in challenging low-light and adverse weather conditions. Notably, InfraNet maintains high efficiency in IR-only inference, making it both accurate and computationally efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出InfraNet，一种以红外为中心、质量感知的多模态目标检测框架，支持RGB-IR或仅红外部署，通过QualGate模块抑制不可靠RGB信息，在四个基准数据集上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有融合方法在训练和推理时对RGB和IR模态同等对待，导致RGB模态不可靠或缺失时鲁棒性严重下降。亟需一种不依赖RGB可用性的鲁棒检测方案。
AI.method: 提出非对称架构InfraNet：主路径为IR特征提取用于预测，辅助路径为RGB提供可靠性控制的监督信号。核心模块QualGate学习任务导向的控制信号，抑制不可靠RGB引导并补偿IR特征。据此设计两个变体：仅红外InfraNet-IR和RGB-IR融合InfraNet-RGB-IR。
AI.result: 在LLVIP、FLIR-Aligned、M³FD、DroneVehicle四个基准数据集上，在低光照和恶劣天气等挑战条件下，取得了强竞争力或最优的检测精度。仅红外推理时保持高效率。
AI.conclusion: InfraNet成功解决了多模态目标检测中RGB模态不可靠时的鲁棒性问题，以IR为中心的架构设计兼顾了准确性和计算效率，为实际恶劣环境下的部署提供了可行方案。

title: Enhancing Implicit Neural Representations with Image Feature Embedding for Unsupervised Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
summary: Cardiac cine Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is a critical diagnostic tool that provides dynamic insights for radiologists. To accelerate acquisition, under-sampled k-space data is often used, requiring reconstruction methods that combine coil sensitivity encoding with prior information to recover missing data. Deep learning approaches have gained more attention for leveraging data-adaptive priors. While supervised learning approaches are a common choice, they depend on fully sampled reference data, which is not always available. Unsupervised methods eliminate the need for fully sampled reference data, which can be advantageous in cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. Among them, implicit neural representations (INRs) have shown great potential due to their simple architecture and good quality reconstructions. In this work, we propose an image-domain dual-branch INR framework, termed I-FP-INR, which extends the original INR design by introducing an additional feature-processing branch. This design aims to extract complementary feature embeddings to enhance the overall representation, thereby benefiting reconstruction. Extensive evaluations on both public datasets and in-house data show consistent improvements over baseline methods in reconstruction quality, with strong robustness across varied scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种图像域双分支隐式神经表示框架(I-FP-INR)，通过额外特征处理分支增强MRI重建质量，在公开和内部数据集上均优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 传统有监督学习方法依赖全采样参考数据，而临床中此类数据不易获取。无监督方法可避免此问题，其中隐式神经表示(INR)因架构简单、重建质量好而备受关注，但现有INR方法仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 提出I-FP-INR框架，在原始INR基础上引入一个额外的特征处理分支（双分支设计），用于提取互补的特征嵌入，增强整体表示能力，从而改善心脏电影MRI的重建效果。
AI.result: 在公开数据集和内部数据集上的广泛评估表明，该方法在重建质量上持续优于基线方法，并在多种场景下展现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: I-FP-INR作为一种无监督的图像域双分支INR框架，能够有效提升心脏电影MRI重建质量，且无需全采样参考数据，具有良好的泛化能力和实用性。

title: Probabilistic Robustness in Medical Image Classification
summary: Deep learning (DL) has shown strong performance in medical image classification, but its trustworthy deployment remains challenging in safety-critical clinical settings, where prediction errors under perturbations may lead to severe consequences. Existing studies mainly focus on adversarial robustness (AR) from a worst-case perspective; however, such settings may be less representative of real medical applications. In this work, we investigate probabilistic robustness (PR) as a more practical measure of model trustworthiness. To this end, we construct a set of natural corruption settings for medical image classification and systematically evaluate commonly used DL models on MedMNIST v2 dataset. Our study provides a statistically grounded perspective on assessing the trustworthiness of DL models, thereby supporting their more trustworthy deployment in medical imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概率鲁棒性作为医学图像分类中更实际的模型可信度度量，并在MedMNIST v2数据集上系统评估了常见深度学习模型在自然损坏场景下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的对抗鲁棒性研究多从最坏情况角度评估模型，这在真实临床场景中不够代表性。需要更实际的鲁棒性度量标准来支持模型在安全关键的医疗环境中的可信部署。
AI.method: 针对医学图像分类构建一组自然损坏场景，在MedMNIST v2数据集上系统评估常见深度学习模型，采用概率鲁棒性作为统计层面的可信度度量。
AI.result: 通过实验提供了深度学习模型在自然扰动下性能表现的统计评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 概率鲁棒性可作为更实用的模型可信度评估指标，有助于推动深度学习模型在医学影像应用中的可信部署。

title: Seeing Once is Enough? Online Geometry-Aware Token Pruning for 3D Question Answering
comment: published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Efficient Spatial Reasoning
summary: Recent Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on 2D question answering tasks. However, extending these models to the 3D question answering remains challenging, as they typically require multiple views of the scene, which incurs substantial computational cost at inference. To mitigate this issue, existing solutions rely on strategic frame selection or token-merging algorithms that require preprocessing in advance all frames of the scene, i.e., an offline fashion. In contrast, we propose the first online token-pruning method that can be integrated seamlessly with current MLLM models for 3D question answering tasks, without additional training and with lower memory usage.Our key insight is to project each input frame into a shared voxel space using depth information and camera pose, identifying spatially-overlapped regions across frames and selectively pruning redundant image tokens before they enter the language model. Our method enables efficient online processing while reducing up to 50% of token usage. We apply this approach to Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, demonstrating improved performance on the ScanQA, SQA3D, and OpenEQA-HM3D benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个无需额外训练、可在线运行的3D问答令牌剪枝方法，通过深度信息和相机位姿将输入帧投影到共享体素空间，识别并移除跨帧空间重叠区域的冗余图像令牌，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B上减少50%令牌用量，并在ScanQA、SQA3D、OpenEQA-HM3D基准上提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D MLLM模型需要多视角场景输入，推理时计算成本高昂；现有解决方案（如帧选择或令牌合并）需预处理所有帧（离线方式），无法高效在线处理。
AI.method: 利用深度信息和相机位姿将每帧图像投影到共享体素空间，识别跨帧的空间重叠区域，在令牌进入语言模型之前选择性地剪除冗余图像令牌，实现无需额外训练的在线剪枝。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B上，减少高达50%的令牌使用量，并在ScanQA、SQA3D、OpenEQA-HM3D基准上取得性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出的在线令牌剪枝方法能无缝集成到现有MLLM中，以更低内存和计算成本实现高效3D问答，是首个在线方案。

title: SOV-CAD: Stepwise Orthographic Views Guided CAD Modeling Sequence Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing Computer-Aided Design (CAD) modeling sequences from images is crucial for preserving design intent and supporting parametric editing. However, existing methods typically generate full CAD sequences holistically, overlooking the iterative, feedback-driven nature of human design workflows. We address this limitation by introducing the rich stepwise visual supervision: at each modeling step, the system observes the target's orthographic projections, the projections of the incrementally constructed model, and the active sketch, enabling informed action selection. To effectively leverage this on-the-fly feedback, we propose SOV-CAD, a framework that formulates CAD reconstruction as a sequential decision-making task and employs offline reinforcement learning with a Decision Transformer architecture. This design incorporates continuous visual feedback guided by geometric alignment rewards, resulting in a more accurate and human-like modeling process. Extensive experiments show that SOV-CAD surpasses state-of-the-art methods in CAD sequence reconstruction while exhibiting strong data efficiency. Code of SOV-CAD is available at: https://github.com/LukePhong/SOV-CAD

AI.tldr: 提出SOV-CAD框架，利用逐步视觉监督和离线强化学习（Decision Transformer）从图像重建CAD建模序列，效果优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法整体生成CAD序列，忽略了人类设计工作中迭代、反馈驱动的本质，缺乏步骤级的视觉监督。
AI.method: 将CAD重建建模为序列决策任务，使用离线强化学习与Decision Transformer架构，在每个建模步骤中利用目标正交投影、增量模型投影和活动草图作为视觉反馈，并引入几何对齐奖励指导。
AI.result: 在CAD序列重建任务上超越当前最先进方法，并展现出较强的数据效率。
AI.conclusion: SOV-CAD通过步骤级视觉反馈和强化学习实现了更准确、更类人的CAD建模序列重建，代码已开源。

title: TestMate: Test-Time Domain Adaptation Aided by Lightweight Vision Foundation Model
summary: Test-Time Domain Adaptation (TTDA) aims to adapt Deep Neural Networks to distribution shifts using only streaming, unlabeled test data in real time. Current methods for semantic segmentation tasks suffer from critical limitations. Entropy minimization techniques require costly backpropagation, risking catastrophic forgetting and producing noisy segmentation boundaries. Memory-bank methods, while backpropagation-free, exhibit slow adaptation, requiring numerous samples to converge and struggle to handle continuous domain shifts. We introduce TestMate, a novel, real-time, and backpropagation-free TTDA framework that overcomes these issues. TestMate leverages generalization capability of a lightweight Visual Foundation Model to guide the adaptation. We use a zero-shot instance segmentation YOLOv8-seg based model to generate unlabeled mask proposals for objects and their parts at multiple scales in real time. These proposals are fused with the primary model via a heuristic, size-ordered competitive scheme, where small, high-confidence regions dominate and refine predictions in surrounding larger, less certain areas. This paremeter-free mechanism enables immediate adaptation from the first frame, inherently avoids catastrophic forgetting and effectively preserves fine object details and boundaries, even for small objects. TestMate can be used as a standalone, efficient refinement module or seamlessly integrated into existing TTDA methods to significantly boost their performance. We demonstrate state-of-the-art results across two benchmark datasets, proving TestMate's effectiveness in three distinct adaptation tasks: TTDA, Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA), and online-TTDA. Code is available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TestMate，一种无需反向传播的实时测试时域适应框架，利用轻量级视觉基础模型生成多尺度实例分割提议，通过大小排序的竞争机制融合到主模型中，在语义分割任务上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有TTDA方法（如熵最小化需要反向传播且易灾难性遗忘，记忆库方法适应缓慢）在处理语义分割任务的连续域偏移时存在严重局限性。
AI.method: 利用YOLOv8-seg零样本实例分割模型实时生成多尺度无标签掩码提议，通过启发式大小排序竞争机制（小高置信区域主导并精炼周围大低置信区域）融合到主模型，无需参数学习。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上取得SOTA结果，在TTDA、SFDA、online-TTDA三种任务中均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: TestMate是一种实时、免反向传播、免参数学习的TTDA框架，能从第一帧开始立即适应，避免灾难性遗忘，保留细粒度边界信息，既可单独使用也可作为模块增强现有方法。

title: Global Logic and Local Search: Dual-Stream Multimodal In-Context Learning for Verifiable Industrial Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. 18 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) show strong few-shot generalization, but industrial anomaly detection remains difficult because defects are small, input resolution is limited, and textual standards are not always grounded in visual evidence. Recent optimization-based methods improve alignment through fine-tuning, but they often require many defective samples, which are unavailable in early deployment. We present Global Logic and Local Search (GLLS), a training-free framework for reference-guided multimodal in-context verification. GLLS uses a Part-Aware Visual-Logical Atlas to organize normal references and structured specifications in the inference context. It combines a Global & Logic Stream, where SAM 3 extracts partially checkable visual facts, with a Fine-Grained & Actions Stream, where MCTS selects local evidence crops under a fixed budget. Experiments on MMAD-QA and additional anomaly detection datasets show consistent gains over matched and general-purpose baselines, while keeping the final diagnostic decision traceable to explicit visual evidence throughout the inspection trace.

AI.tldr: GLLS是一个无需训练的框架，通过视觉-逻辑图谱和双流推理（全局逻辑流+细粒度行为流）实现工业异常检测，在MMAD-QA等基准上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LMMs在工业异常检测中面临缺陷小、分辨率受限、文本标准与视觉证据不对齐等挑战；微调方法需要大量缺陷样本，早期部署不可行。
AI.method: 提出GLLS框架：1）构建Part-Aware Visual-Logical Atlas组织正常参考和结构化规范；2）Global & Logic Stream用SAM 3提取可部分检查的视觉事实；3）Fine-Grained & Actions Stream用MCTS在固定预算下选择局部证据裁剪。
AI.result: 在MMAD-QA及其他异常检测数据集上，GLLS一致优于匹配的基线和通用基线，且诊断决策可追溯到明确的视觉证据。
AI.conclusion: GLLS通过训练免费的多模态上下文验证，有效解决了工业异常检测中小缺陷和视觉-文本不对齐问题，同时保持了可解释性。

title: TRISTAR: Triple-Signal Stair Recognition and Vision-Only Indoor Navigation for Search-and-Rescue Micro-UAVs
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. Project repository available at: https://github.com/tavigingu/HawkOps-Indoor-Drone-Navigation-and-TRISTAR-Stair-Climbing
summary: Indoor search-and-rescue (SAR) operations often require rapid situational awareness where GNSS signals are unavailable and human access is difficult or hazardous. While most autonomous aerial systems rely on LiDAR, stereo vision, or specialized depth cameras, such solutions increase both hardware complexity and deployment costs. This paper presents a complete autonomous indoor navigation framework for low-cost unmanned aerial vehicles based exclusively on monocular vision. Implemented on a DJI Tello platform, the system combines monocular depth estimation using Depth Anything V2 with classical computer vision and lightweight deep learning models for scene understanding, victim detection, and hazard recognition. The framework consists of two independent behaviors: (i) corridor exploration with automatic door detection, room entry, OCR-based room identification, and victim inspection; and (ii) autonomous stair ascent based on TRISTAR (TRI-Signal STair Ascent Recognition), a novel triple-sensor fusion method that integrates structural cues (Sobel filtering), texture analysis (multi-scale Gabor filtering), and geometric depth from monocular depth estimation. Evaluation used real indoor flights in a university building. Depth calibration reduced relative depth error from 27.4% to below 10%, while the door detection algorithm reached a precision of 0.93 and an F1-score of 0.91. A dedicated ablation study shows that multi-sensor fusion significantly improves stair-recognition robustness compared to individual sensing modalities, and a failure-case analysis delineates the limits of monocular perception under challenging lighting and reflective surfaces. The results demonstrate that reliable indoor exploration and stair traversal are achievable on resource-constrained platforms without specialized ranging hardware, a practical, cost-effective solution for rapid SAR deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于单目视觉的低成本无人机自主室内导航框架，在DJI Tello平台上实现，结合深度估计、经典CV与轻量级深度学习模型，实现了走廊探索、门检测、房间识别、受害者检测以及自主爬楼梯（TRISTAR多传感器融合方法），在真实室内飞行中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 室内搜索救援任务需要快速态势感知，但GNSS信号不可用，且现有方案依赖LiDAR、立体视觉等昂贵硬件，增加了部署成本和复杂度。本文旨在探索仅依靠单目视觉的低成本解决方案。
AI.method: 基于DJI Tello平台，结合Depth Anything V2单目深度估计、经典计算机视觉与轻量级深度学习模型。框架包含两个独立行为：(1) 走廊探索，含自动门检测、房间进入、OCR房间识别、受害者检查；(2) 基于TRISTAR方法的自主爬楼梯，融合Sobel结构线索、多尺度Gabor纹理分析及单目几何深度三种信号。
AI.result: 深度校准将相对深度误差从27.4%降至10%以下；门检测算法精确率0.93，F1-score 0.91；消融实验证明多传感器融合显著提升楼梯识别鲁棒性；失败案例分析揭示了单目视觉在光照和反射表面下的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 在资源受限的平台上，无需专用测距硬件即可实现可靠的室内探索和楼梯遍历，为快速SAR部署提供了实用、低成本的解决方案。

title: HCSU: A Dataset and Benchmark for Fine-Grained Historical Calligraphy Style Understanding
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. 17 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables
summary: Automated fine-grained perception of calligraphy styles--a task vital to cultural heritage preservation--remains a critical challenge for Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), largely constrained by existing datasets that suffer from modal mixture and flattened labels. To bridge this gap, we introduce HCSU, the first comprehensive dataset tailored for fine-grained Historical Calligraphy Style Understanding. HCSU comprises 39,307 meticulously curated character images from 49 historically prominent calligraphers across 10 dynasties, systematically decoupling authentic ink manuscripts (Tie) from stone rubbings (Bei) to resolve the long-standing modal mixture problem. Moving beyond conventional flattened labels, HCSU provides hierarchical expert-written aesthetic descriptions, enabling two rigorous evaluation protocols: fine-grained style discrimination and interpretable aesthetic reasoning. Extensive evaluations reveal a persistent gap between calligraphy-related knowledge and visually grounded style perception: state-of-the-art LVLMs show non-trivial performance but remain sensitive to script-level, textual, and source-specific cues, and often struggle to ground aesthetic judgments in fine-grained brushwork evidence. Ultimately, the HCSU benchmark exposes fundamental limitations in current multimodal architectures, aiming to inspire the evolution of expert-level visual reasoning for cultural heritage preservation. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tongji209/HCSU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HCSU——首个面向历史书法风格细粒度理解的综合数据集，包含39,307张高质量书法字图像，解耦了墨迹与拓本模态，并提供层级式专家美学描述。实验揭示现有LVLMs在细粒度风格感知上存在显著局限。
AI.motivation: 现有书法风格理解数据集存在模态混杂（墨迹与拓本混淆）和标签扁平化两大问题，限制了LVLMs的细粒度感知能力，亟需一个解耦模态、层次化标注的高质量数据集。
AI.method: 构建了HCSU数据集：收集49位书法家、10个朝代的39,307张图像，系统区分墨迹与拓本；提供层级式专家撰写的美学描述；设计了细粒度风格判别和可解释美学推理两种评估协议。
AI.result: 最先进的LVLMs虽展现一定能力，但高度依赖书体、文本内容及来源线索，难以基于笔法证据进行细粒度美学判断，揭示出书法知识与视觉感知之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: HCSU基准暴露了当前多模态架构在专家级视觉推理上的根本性局限，旨在推动文化遗产保护领域朝向更具细粒度感知能力的发展方向。

title: FDR-Occ: Factorized Dense Routing for Full-Spectrum 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction fundamentally relies on the 2D-to-3D view transformation. Current paradigms predominantly utilize explicit physical projection, which artificially restricts the routing matrix to strict, sparse camera rays. While computationally efficient, this imposes a severe Locality Bottleneck, preventing the network from constructing holistic contextual understanding and degrading sharply when camera extrinsics are unreliable or absent. To break this bottleneck, we abstract view transformation as unconstrained bipartite routing and propose Factorized Dense Routing (FDR). By approximating dense 2D-to-3D mixing through hierarchical tensor contractions, FDR guarantees a fully-global receptive field with tractable, sub-quadratic complexity. Crucially, the mandatory spatial contraction in dense routing exposes a fundamental Resolution-Context Trade-off. To address this, we introduce a Resolution-Context Decoupled Architecture. We factorize the 3D space into a global macroscopic topological anchor (via FDR) and precise local geometric planes (via explicit projection). This decoupling enables global semantic inference and exact surface localization to complement each other without mutual compromise. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Occ3D-nuScenes and Occ3D-Waymo benchmarks. More notably, in an uncalibrated setting where physical extrinsics are withheld, our global routing internalizes the implicit multi-camera rig topology and exhibits substantially stronger structural robustness than physical-projection baselines under the same protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因子化密集路由（FDR）和分辨率-上下文解耦架构，通过层次化张量收缩近似密集2D到3D混合，打破显式物理投影导致的局部性瓶颈，在无标定设置下实现强鲁棒的3D占据预测，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于显式物理投影的2D-to-3D视角变换方法存在严重的局部性瓶颈（Locality Bottleneck），其路由矩阵被限制在稀疏的相机射线上，无法构建全局上下文理解，且在相机外参不可靠或缺失时性能急剧下降。
AI.method: 1）将视角变换抽象为无约束的二部路由，提出因子化密集路由（FDR），通过层次化张量收缩近似密集2D-3D混合，实现全全局感受野且复杂度为次二次。2）提出分辨率-上下文解耦架构，将3D空间分解为全局拓扑锚点（通过FDR）和精确局部几何平面（通过显式投影），使全局语义推理与精确表面定位互补而不互相妥协。
AI.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes和Occ3D-Waymo基准上达到SOTA性能；在无标定（外参缺失）设置下，全局路由内化了隐式多相机拓扑结构，展现出比物理投影基线更强的结构鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 打破局部性瓶颈的关键在于将视角变换从物理约束中解放为自由路由；分辨率-上下文解耦架构有效解决了密集路由中固有的分辨率-上下文权衡问题。

title: SeeMe: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models through Effective Visual Token Engineering
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual understanding tasks such as image captioning and visual question answering. However, they remain susceptible to hallucinations, generating content that is inconsistent with the actual visual input. Existing methods primarily intervene at the decoding stage, while overlooking a critical source of hallucinations: irrelevant or noisy visual tokens that mislead the decoding process. To address this issue, we propose SeeMe, a training-free framework that introduces the concept of feature engineering from traditional machine learning into LVLMs. SeeMe restructures visual tokens through a three-stage token engineering process to suppress hallucination sources while preserving informative visual evidence. Experiments on MME, POPE, and AMBER benchmarks across four LVLMs demonstrate that SeeMe consistently reduces hallucinations and improves output consistency, providing a novel perspective for mitigating hallucinations in LVLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeeMe，一个无需训练的三阶段视觉令牌工程框架，通过特征工程思想重构视觉令牌以抑制LVLM中的幻觉问题，实验表明该方法在多个基准上有效减少了幻觉并提升输出一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM在视觉理解任务中仍存在幻觉问题，即生成与视觉输入不一致的内容。已有方法主要干预解码阶段，但忽略了幻觉的关键来源——无关或噪声视觉令牌误导了解码过程。
AI.method: 提出SeeMe，一个无需训练的框架，将传统机器学习中的特征工程概念引入LVLM。通过三阶段令牌工程（token engineering）重构视觉令牌：抑制幻觉来源的同时保留有信息量的视觉证据。
AI.result: 在MME、POPE、AMBER三个基准上，对四种不同LVLM进行实验，结果表明SeeMe能够持续减少幻觉并提升输出一致性。
AI.conclusion: SeeMe为缓解LVLM中的幻觉问题提供了一个全新的视角，通过特征工程在输入层面而非解码层面干预，证明了视觉令牌质量对幻觉控制的重要性。

title: CritiqueDriveVLM: From Verifier-Guided Reinforcement Learning to Latent Thought Distillation for Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show immense potential in autonomous driving. However, standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) often suffers from reasoning hallucinations and conservative biases. While traditional tool-augmented frameworks and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) approaches mitigate these issues, they incur exorbitant token consumption and unacceptable latency, rendering real-time deployment impractical. To resolve this reliability-efficiency trade-off, we propose CritiqueDriveVLM, a novel unified three-stage framework internalizing reasoning directly into the VLM. First, we introduce Critique-Driven Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning (RL) guided by a multi-dimensional verifier. By providing granular scalar feedback and a multi-turn penalty, we force the policy to internalize logical deduction, cultivating a robust System-2 Teacher that achieves high accuracy without fragile external tools. Subsequently, we propose Latent Thought Distillation to overcome the latency bottleneck. By aligning the Student's latent representations with the Teacher's fully converged reasoning states, we compress deep logical capabilities into a fast, CoT-free System-1 Student. Extensive experiments on the widely-used DriveLMM-01 benchmark demonstrate remarkable improvements. Compared to the base model, our tool-free Teacher significantly boosts Multiple Choice Quality (MCQ) from 55.54% to a state-of-the-art 76.54%. Crucially, our distilled Student preserves competitive reasoning depth while drastically minimizing generation length to an average of merely 28 tokens. This slashes inference latency by 88% (from 3482 ms to 416 ms), paving a highly robust pathway for low-latency autonomous driving.Our source code is available at https://github.com/MICLAB-BUPT/CritiqueDriveVLM.

AI.tldr: 提出CritiqueDriveVLM框架，通过多轮强化学习内化推理能力，再通过潜在思维蒸馏压缩为快速推理模型，在DriveLMM-01基准上将MCQ从55.54%提升到76.54%，同时推理延迟降低88%（从3482ms到416ms），平均仅生成28个token。
AI.motivation: 标准SFT导致推理幻觉和保守偏差，现有工具增强和CoT方法虽能缓解但延迟过高，难以实时部署，需要解决可靠性与效率之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架：1) 基于多维验证器的批判驱动多轮强化学习，内化逻辑推理得到System-2 Teacher；2) 潜在思维蒸馏，将Teacher的推理状态对齐到Student的潜在表征，压缩为无CoT的快速System-1 Student。
AI.result: MCQ从55.54%提升到76.54%（SOTA）；推理延迟从3482ms降至416ms（降低88%）；平均生成长度仅28个token。
AI.conclusion: 成功解决了VLM在自动驾驶中可靠性与效率的权衡问题，通过内化推理+知识蒸馏实现了高精度与低延迟的兼顾。

title: Hierarchical Multi-to-Single-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Disruption Prediction in EAST
summary: Plasma disruption is a critical threat to tokamak safety. Existing data-driven predictors mainly rely on time-series diagnostic signals, while visible images provide complementary spatial cues including plasma deformation, local brightening, and radiation-structure evolution. Although the image modality improves the model's discriminative capability, it also substantially increases the computational cost during inference. To address this issue, we propose a hierarchical multi-to-single-modal knowledge distillation framework for disruption prediction on a synchronized EAST multimodal dataset. During training, visible images and time-series signals are used to train a multimodal teacher, which learns disruption precursor representations through Transformer-based encoders and a prototype-guided spatiotemporal hypergraph module. During inference, only the time-series student is retained, with multimodal knowledge transferred through graph-structure-level, representation-level, and decision-level distillation. On the 640-discharge EAST dataset, the results demonstrate that the proposed framework can preserve the discriminative advantages of multimodal learning while substantially reducing inference cost, and providing an effective route for efficient disruption prediction in EAST. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion.

AI.tldr: 提出一种层次化多模态到单模态知识蒸馏框架，在训练时使用可见光图像和时序信号训练多模态教师模型，推理时仅保留时序学生模型，通过图结构、表征和决策三个层次的蒸馏传递多模态知识，实现兼具多模态判别优势与低推理成本的托卡马克等离子体破裂预测。
AI.motivation: 等离子体破裂预测中，可见光图像能提供空间线索但大幅增加推理计算成本，现有方法缺乏在保持多模态判别能力的同时降低推理开销的有效方案。
AI.method: 提出层次化多模态到单模态知识蒸馏框架：教师模型（训练阶段）使用Transformer编码器和原型引导的时空超图模块融合图像与时序信号；学生模型（推理阶段）仅使用时序信号，通过图结构级、表征级、决策级三个层次的蒸馏从教师迁移知识。
AI.result: 在包含640次放电的EAST数据集上，该框架保留了多模态学习的判别优势，同时显著降低了推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 为EAST托卡马克提供了一种高效的破裂预测路径，兼顾多模态信息优势与单模态推理效率。

title: ContiStain: Cross-Domain Relation-Preserving Distillation for Continual Multi-Domain Virtual IHC Staining
summary: A unified multiplex virtual staining model enables scalable and non-destructive multiplex analysis from H&E slides while promoting parameter efficiency, shared pathological knowledge, and consistent cross-biomarker representations. However, in clinical practice, data for new biomarkers are typically acquired sequentially over time. Fine-tuning on such temporally arriving data leads to severe performance degradation on previously learned biomarkers, as sequential optimization disrupts the structured relationships among biomarker representations in the latent space. To address this issue, we propose ContiStain, an IHC multi-domain relational distillation framework for continual virtual staining. We first (i) construct a domain-aware structured feature space using a mixture-of-experts (MoE) feature extractor to reduce representation interference across biomarker domains. Based on this stabilized feature space, we then (ii) propose a relation-preserving distillation strategy that explicitly enforces the consistency of cross-domain token-level cosine similarity matrices between learned biomarker domains during continual adaptation. By maintaining cross-domain structural coherence, ContiStain mitigates forgetting while retaining adaptability to new domains. Experiments on the MIST dataset under a four-domain sequential virtual IHC staining setting show improved stability, reducing FID and ConchFID by 11.1 and 60.9 compared to sequential fine-tuning, enabling scalable and robust multi-domain virtual staining. Code is released at https://github.com/ccitachi/ContiStain.

AI.tldr: ContiStain 提出了一种基于多域关系蒸馏的连续虚拟染色框架，通过 MoE 特征提取器和关系保持蒸馏策略，在顺序学习新生物标志物时有效缓解灾难性遗忘，在 MIST 数据集上显著提升了稳定性和生成质量。
AI.motivation: 临床实践中新生物标志物数据通常是按时间顺序获得的，对顺序到达的数据进行微调会严重破坏之前学过的生物标志物性能（灾难性遗忘），因为顺序优化打乱了潜在空间中 biomarker 表示之间的结构化关系。
AI.method: 1. 使用混合专家（MoE）特征提取器构建领域感知的结构化特征空间，减少不同 biomarker 域之间的表示干扰；2. 提出关系保持蒸馏策略，在连续适应过程中显式保持已学 biomarker 域之间 Token 级余弦相似性矩阵的一致性，维持跨域结构连贯性。
AI.result: 在 MIST 数据集上的四域顺序虚拟 IHC 染色实验中，相比顺序微调，FID 降低 11.1，ConchFID 降低 60.9，显著提升了稳定性。
AI.conclusion: ContiStain 通过维持跨域结构相干性，在缓解遗忘的同时保留了对新域的适应能力，实现了可扩展且鲁棒的多域虚拟染色。

title: CogRad: A Cognitively-Inspired Multi-Agent Framework for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Automated radiology report generation (RRG) can ease radiologist workload, yet most existing systems produce a report in a single forward pass, with no mechanism to check a claim against the image or revisit a finding once stated. We present CogRad, a cognitively inspired multi-agent framework that structures generation around four stages of a radiologist's reading process. A Scout agent discovers anatomical regions directly from image patches via slot attention and assigns region and disease-level triage scores; an Investigator agent concentrates representational capacity on the regions Scout flags as suspicious; a Writer agent compiles these signals into a disease gated visual prefix for a large language model; and a Verifier agent supervises training with a visual entailment loss and, at inference, re-examines its own draft sentence by sentence, regenerating any report it judges insufficiently grounded. On CheXpert Plus, CogRad attains a BLEU-4 of 0.316 and a CIDEr of 0.322, the best scores among the methods we compare against. On IU X-Ray, it attains a BLEU-4 of 0.201 and a CIDEr of 0.724, leading every baseline on every standard NLG metric. We further evaluate CogRad with RadGraph F1, CheXbert F1, and a hallucination analysis to assess clinical accuracy beyond standard text-overlap metrics, complemented by ablation studies and Grad-CAM-based visualizations that characterize each agent's contribution and the model's visual grounding.

AI.tldr: CogRad提出了一个受认知科学启发的多智能体框架，将放射报告生成分解为侦察、调查、撰写和验证四个阶段，从而实现了基于图像的分步检查和报告修正，在CheXpert Plus和IU X-Ray数据集上获得了领先的NLG指标和临床准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有放射报告生成系统多采用单次前向传播方式，缺乏对图像中发现的回溯验证机制，导致报告可能包含与图像不符的虚假内容。作者希望模拟放射科医师的实际阅片认知过程，让模型能够分阶段逐步检查并自我修正。
AI.method: CogRad包含四个智能体：(1) Scout通过slot注意力从图像块中检测解剖区域并分配三级分诊分数；(2) Investigator集中表征能力于Scout标记的疑似区域；(3) Writer将信号转化为疾病门控视觉前缀，输入大语言模型生成报告；(4) Verifier在训练时使用视觉蕴含损失监督，在推理时逐句重新检查草稿，对证据不足的句子进行重新生成。
AI.result: 在CheXpert Plus上BLEU-4达到0.316、CIDEr达到0.322，在IU X-Ray上BLEU-4达到0.201、CIDEr达到0.724，均为对比方法中最佳。此外还使用RadGraph F1、CheXbert F1和幻觉分析评估了临床准确性，并通过消融实验和Grad-CAM可视化验证了各智能体的贡献。
AI.conclusion: CogRad通过模拟放射科医师的认知过程，有效提升了报告生成的准确性和可验证性，尤其是在文本-图像对齐和减少幻觉方面表现突出，为可解释的医学报告生成提供了新范式。

title: IRIS: An Intelligent Vision-Language System for Ocular Surface Diseases via Topic Tree and Scene-Driven VQA Generation
summary: While Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable generic capabilities, their clinical reasoning in specialized domains like ocular surface diseases (OSDs) is severely hindered by a paucity of high-fidelity, multimodal instruction-tuning data. To dismantle this data bottleneck, we introduce IRIS, an Intelligent Recognition and Interaction System tailored for fine-grained OSD understanding via external eye photography. First, we curate IRIS-120K, the largest and most comprehensive OSD visual question-answering (VQA) dataset to date. Crucially, to overcome the semantic shallowness of conventional image-caption pairs, we propose a synergistic data generation paradigm to explicitly inject clinical priors. Our data engine operates via a dual-branch framework: 1) a Topic Finding Tree (TFT) that hierarchically anchors visual features to precise anatomical and pathological concepts, enforcing rigorous medical deduction logic; and 2) a Scene-driven strategy that synthesizes role-adaptive clinical dialogues to ensure pragmatic generalization. By explicitly aligning a compact 4B-parameter VLM on this structurally enriched corpus, IRIS achieves state-of-the-art performance, comprehensively outperforming both generalist and specialized medical VLMs with up to 34B parameters. Our findings underscore that structured knowledge injection profoundly prevails over sheer parameter scaling, unlocking the potential for resource-efficient, expert-level AI deployment on mobile edge devices for scalable OSD screening. Code, datasets, and model weights will be publicly released by this repo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IRIS系统，通过构建大规模眼表疾病VQA数据集IRIS-120K和双分支数据引擎（主题查找树+场景驱动策略）注入临床先验知识，使4B参数的VLM在眼表疾病细粒度理解上超越34B参数的通用和医学专用模型。
AI.motivation: 大规模视觉语言模型在眼表疾病等专业领域存在临床推理能力不足的问题，根本原因是缺乏高质量、多模态的指令微调数据。
AI.method: 1) 构建IRIS-120K眼表疾病VQA数据集；2) 提出双分支协同数据生成范式：Topic Finding Tree (TFT) 层次化锚定视觉特征到解剖/病理概念，Scene-driven策略合成角色自适应临床对话；3) 在4B参数VLM上对齐该结构化语料。
AI.result: 4B参数的IRIS在眼表疾病理解任务上全面超越通用和医学专用VLMs（最高34B参数），达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化知识注入比单纯扩大参数规模更有效，为资源受限的移动边缘设备上部署专家级AI进行眼表疾病筛查提供了可行路径。

title: PRISM3D: Probabilistic Refinement and Robust Initialization for Physically Consistent Scene Modeling under Extreme Motion Blur
summary: We address the inverse problem of blind 3D scene reconstruction from extremely motion-blurred images, a scenario where traditional Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipelines fail. Existing approaches typically circumvent this bottleneck by relying on impractical sharp-image supervision. In this work, we introduce PRISM3D, a unified framework enabling robust reconstruction directly from severely degraded inputs. To overcome the lack of a reliable starting point, we propose a Robust Initialization strategy utilizing deep dense tracking method (VGGSfM) to recover global topology where feature matching fails. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to effectively leverage this paradigm to bootstrap 3D Gaussian Splatting from extreme motion blur. However, while robust, this initialization yields sparse and noisy geometry that causes deterministic optimization to diverge. To resolve this, we propose a coupled solution driven by probability and physics: we adopt a probabilistic formulation for geometric densification via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) to robustly populate the sparse priors, while simultaneously modeling physical image formation via continuous Bezier Trajectories. Furthermore, while PRISM3D establishes a highly robust standalone pipeline, the availability of complementary event streams offers an opportunity to push the reconstruction fidelity further. To exploit this, we introduce PRISM3D-E, a multi-modal (RGB + Events) extension that seamlessly integrates high-temporal-resolution events as structural priors to maximize geometric recovery. Because existing datasets lack paired event streams under such severe degradation, we concurrently contribute the PRISM3D-E Benchmark to facilitate rigorous evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that both our standalone RGB framework and its multi-modal extension establish new state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出PRISM3D框架，首次实现直接从极端运动模糊图像进行盲3D场景重建，通过鲁棒初始化、概率几何致密化和物理图像建模解决传统SfM失效问题，并扩展出融合事件流的多模态版本PRISM3D-E及配套基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 传统SfM管线在极端运动模糊图像上完全失效，现有方法依赖不切实际的清晰图像监督。亟需一种能从严重退化输入中直接进行鲁棒3D重建的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出PRISM3D框架，包含：(1) 利用深度稠密跟踪方法(VGGSfM)的鲁棒初始化策略恢复全局拓扑；(2) 基于MCMC的概率公式进行几何致密化以鲁棒地填充稀疏先验；(3) 通过连续贝塞尔轨迹建模物理图像形成。多模态扩展PRISM3D-E引入高时间分辨率事件流作为结构先验，并贡献对应基准数据集。
AI.result: 在极端运动模糊场景下，PRISM3D及其多模态扩展PRISM3D-E均取得了新的最优性能，实验证明该框架能有效实现从严重退化输入到高质量3D场景的重建。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明了从极端运动模糊图像直接引导3D高斯泼溅的可行性，概率与物理耦合的解决方案兼具鲁棒性与高效性，多模态融合进一步提升了重建保真度。

title: HASSL: Hierarchy-Aware Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Single Cell Microscopy
summary: Hierarchical structure is common in image data, where fine-grained clusters often merge into larger, coarser semantic groups. In biological cell images, current self-supervised learning models often suppress this hierarchy, as coarse factors such as imaging modality can obscure finer morphological attributes in the latent space. We propose a hierarchy-aware self-supervised training framework to address this problem. Our method combines two components: a distillation framework with a segmentation teacher to improve morphological awareness in the latent space, and a hierarchy-aware contrastive loss based on HDBSCAN to improve decision boundaries between closely related subtypes at different hierarchical levels. Together, these components reduce the tendency of self-supervised learning to overemphasize coarse factors and instead align embeddings with semantic and morphological cues. This yields biologically meaningful sub-clusters driven by fine morphological detail. We train and evaluate our method on a curated corpus of 2.3 million single cells aggregated from 20 microscopy datasets, both labeled and unlabeled, covering 208 cell classes. Our method improves over baseline and counterpart methods, increasing average top-K accuracy by 2.8%, top-9 retrieval on the dataset with the deepest hierarchy by 6.3%, and downstream F1-score for biologically relevant drug classification from perturbed cell morphology by 7.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个层级感知的自监督学习框架，结合分割教师蒸馏和HDBSCAN对比损失，在230万细胞图像上提升了层次细粒度分类和下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的自监督学习方法在细胞图像中会压制层级结构（如成像模态掩盖了精细形态特征），导致粗粒度因素主导隐空间，细粒度子类边界模糊。
AI.method: 1）分割教师蒸馏框架增强隐空间的形态感知能力；2）基于HDBSCAN的层级感知对比损失，在不同层级上优化子类决策边界。
AI.result: 在230万细胞（208类）数据上，Top-K准确率提升2.8%，最深层次数据集Top-9检索提升6.3%，药物分类F1提升7.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效缓解了自监督学习过度强调粗粒度因素的问题，使嵌入更对齐语义和形态线索，生成生物学上有意义的细粒度子簇。

title: Ghosts Beneath Textures: Texture-Relation Cues for Cross-Paradigm AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated images have proliferated rapidly, motivating extensive research. Most existing AI-generated image detectors are developed and evaluated under image-free generation paradigms, such as noise-based or text-guided generation. However, image-conditioned generation has become increasingly important in practical applications, as it enables more fine-grained control over generated content. Detecting AI-generated images across these two paradigms creates a critical cross-paradigm detection problem that has long been overlooked. To study this problem, we construct ConImageGen, a benchmark for cross-paradigm AI-generated image detection. Evaluations on ConImageGen show that existing detectors fail to generalize reliably across image-free and image-conditioned generation. To address this failure, this paper identifies a cross-paradigm forensic cue and provides a new perspective for generalized AI-generated image detection. Specifically, by suppressing semantic interference, we visualize, for the first time, semantics-irrelevant texture patterns across generation paradigms. These patterns exhibit structured local-global texture relations, indicating a generalizable form of forensic evidence. Motivated by this finding, we shift the focus from directly exploiting explicit artifacts to modeling texture relations and propose DTS-Det, a detection framework that captures and leverages such relations for generalized AI-generated image detection. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our method. DTS-Det achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse evaluation settings, reaching 99.6% ACC on ConImageGen with a 10.5% gain over the best baseline. It also achieves 93.2%/94.1% ACC in cross-dataset evaluation on PicoBanana/RAID and maintains detection rates of 95.2%/88.1% under reconstruction attacks and black-box adversarial attacks, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨范式AI生成图像检测问题，构建ConImageGen基准，发现现有检测器无法泛化。通过抑制语义干扰首次可视化跨范式的语义无关纹理模式，并提出基于纹理关系建模的DTS-Det检测框架，在多个评测上达到SOTA（ConImageGen准确率99.6%，比最优基线高10.5%）。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测研究主要针对无图像条件生成范式（如噪声/文本生成），但图像条件生成（如条件扩散模型）在应用中日益重要。这两种范式间的跨范式检测问题长期被忽视，现有检测器无法可靠泛化。
AI.method: 1) 构建ConImageGen跨范式检测基准；2) 通过抑制语义干扰，首次可视化跨范式间语义无关的纹理模式，发现其中存在结构化局部-全局纹理关系；3) 提出DTS-Det框架，从直接利用显式伪影转向建模纹理关系，实现通用检测。
AI.result: ConImageGen上准确率99.6%（比最优基线高10.5%）；跨数据集评估PicoBanana/RAID达93.2%/94.1%；在重建攻击和黑盒对抗攻击下分别保持95.2%/88.1%检测率。
AI.conclusion: 跨范式AI生成图像检测是一个重要但被忽视的问题；纹理关系是一种可泛化的取证线索；DTS-Det通过建模局部-全局纹理关系实现了优异的跨范式、跨数据集和鲁棒检测性能。

title: Transferability Between Understanding and Generation in Unified Multimodal Models
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project Page: this https URL
summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) integrate image understanding and generation within a single architecture, yet how the two tasks interact remains understudied. We investigate $\boldsymbol{\mathsf{transferability}}$ in UMMs: whether training a capability on one task improves the same capability on the other without explicit supervision. Through controlled experiments, we empirically find that transferability depends on architecture-models with fully shared transformer backbone and a unified visual encoder exhibit consistent cross-task transfer, while loosely coupled designs show little or none. Leveraging this transferability, we propose a practical training strategy. The most straightforward way to improve a target generative capability (e.g., counting) is to fine-tune generation directly, but this can degrade visual quality due to distribution shift. Instead, we train the corresponding understanding task and let it transfer into generation, which improves capability-specific generative performance while minimizing distribution shift. We validate this across three capabilities-counting, spatial relation, and text recognition/generation-showing that cross-task transferability can be systematically exploited in UMMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了统一多模态模型（UMMs）中图像理解与生成任务之间的可迁移性，发现完全共享Transformer主干和统一视觉编码器的架构存在跨任务迁移，而松散耦合设计则没有。基于此，提出通过训练理解任务来提升生成任务性能的策略，避免直接微调生成任务导致的质量下降。
AI.motivation: 探索UMMs中理解与生成任务之间的可迁移性，以及如何利用这种迁移性设计更优的训练策略，避免直接微调生成任务带来的分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 通过控制实验，比较不同架构设计（完全共享vs松散耦合）下的跨任务迁移效果；提出“训练理解任务，迁移到生成任务”的训练策略，在计数、空间关系、文本识别/生成三个能力上进行验证。
AI.result: 完全共享Transformer主干和统一视觉编码器的架构表现出稳定的跨任务迁移，而松散耦合设计则几乎没有迁移；提出的理解→生成迁移策略在提升目标生成能力的同时，有效减少了分布偏移。
AI.conclusion: UMMs中理解与生成任务的可迁移性强烈依赖于架构设计，且可以被系统性地利用来提升生成性能，为多模态模型的训练提供了新思路。

title: SharpSplat: Edge-Regularized 3D Gaussian Splatting for High Fidelity Urban Building Reconstruction from UAV images
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) - 2026
summary: Reconstructing high-fidelity 3D building models from UAV imagery is essential for large-scale digital twin development. However, existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) techniques often struggle with building facades, failing to capture sharp geometric transitions. To address this, we propose a semantic edge regularization framework that supervises 3DGS to produce crisp architectural boundaries. Our method leverages SAM 3 to generate precise building masks, from which we extract architecturally significant edges. During training, we align rendered image gradients with these extracted edges, forcing the Gaussians to converge into sharp structural geometries. Evaluations across campus environments, dense urban centers, and custom residential datasets demonstrate significant improvements in edge fidelity without requiring architectural modifications to the 3DGS pipeline. Our approach proves robust across diverse building types, roof geometries, and urban densities.

AI.tldr: 提出一种语义边缘正则化框架，利用SAM 3生成的精确建筑掩码提取边缘，通过对齐渲染图像梯度与提取边缘，使3DGS收敛到清晰的建筑结构几何，从而从无人机图像重建高保真3D建筑模型。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS技术从无人机图像重建建筑模型时，难以捕捉建筑立面的尖锐几何过渡，导致边缘模糊。
AI.method: 使用SAM 3生成精确建筑掩码，从中提取建筑显著边缘；在训练过程中，将渲染图像梯度与提取的边缘对齐，迫使高斯体收敛到清晰的几何结构。
AI.result: 在校园环境、密集城市中心和自定义住宅数据集上的评估表明，该方法在不修改3DGS管线架构的情况下显著提升了边缘保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法对不同建筑类型、屋顶几何和城市密度均具有鲁棒性，可有效提升3D建筑模型重建质量。

title: ResearchStudio-Reel: Automate the Last Mile of Research from Paper to Poster, Video, and Blog
summary: Research dissemination, turning a paper into a poster, a talk video, and a blog post, is still a manual last mile. Prior automation treats each artifact in isolation that each re-extract the paper from scratch, usually ship one-way renders the author cannot reopen in PowerPoint or Word, and gates quality on soft VLM-preference scores that plateau while load-bearing sections still read as empty. We argue this last mile is best built as a composition of skills: thin agent-readable contracts that share one upstream extractor and wrap deterministic primitives in a measured-fill loop whose exits are hard pass/fail render gates. We instantiate this as ResearchStudio-Reel, five Claude Code and Codex skills organized into one shared extractor (Paper2Assets), three editable generators (Paper2Poster, Paper2Video, Paper2Blog), and one interactive convergence layer (Paper2Reel). Paper2Assets extracts each paper once into a shared bundle that can be reused by every downstream skill; The three generators produce a print-ready poster, a synchronized talk video, and a bilingual blog that stay factually consistent and round-trip through PowerPoint or Word; Paper2Reel then binds all three into a self-contained HTML viewer whose section-level clicks jump the video, slides, captions, and blog to matching content. On the Paper2Poster benchmark, our posters lead every aesthetic and information sub-criterion against both prior automated systems and single-shot frontier LLMs, surpassing the authors' own on aesthetics under two held-out VLM judges and winning overall on 84% to 93% of papers; capability audits further show that, by uniquely pairing narration-aligned on-slide highlights with a bilingual blog gated by layout-aware DOCX repair, ResearchStudio-Reel is the only pipeline to ship all three editable artifacts. Project is available at https://aka.ms/ResearchStudio

AI.tldr: 提出ResearchStudio-Reel系统，用智能合约+可编辑生成器+硬性渲染验证的流水线，将论文自动转化为可二次编辑的海报、视频和博客，在质量指标上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 论文传播（制作海报、演讲视频、博客）仍是手动"最后一公里"。现有方法各自为政、生成内容不可编辑（无法在PowerPoint或Word中修改）、质量依赖软性VLML偏好评分，导致关键部分常为空洞内容。
AI.method: 将论文传播分解为多个技能（agent可读合约），共享一个抽取器（Paper2Assets），三个可编辑生成器（海报/视频/博客）采用"测量-填充"循环，通过硬性Pass/Fail渲染门控确保质量，最后用Paper2Reel整合为HTML交互视图。
AI.result: 在Paper2Poster基准测试中，所有美学和信息子指标领先；在84%-93%的论文上整体胜出；是唯一能同时交付三种可编辑工件的流水线。
AI.conclusion: 通过"组合技能"的架构设计（共享抽取+可编辑生成+硬门控验证），能够有效解决论文自动传播的质量和可编辑性问题。

title: MACRO: Training-free Multi-plane Attention for Closeup Render Optimization
summary: Close-up rendering, zooming into a scene well beyond any training camera, is important for virtual production and interactive 3D content, yet remains an open challenge. 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity, real-time novel view synthesis, but its rendering quality degrades at close range. Recent diffusion-based methods that enhance the rendering by conditioning on reference images from the training set produce significant artifacts in this setting. We analyze this failure and identify its root cause: the scale gap between the close-up and reference views. We show that the features in reference-conditioned enhancement models are not scale-invariant, causing cross-view attention to retrieve incorrect correspondences when the same content appears at different scales, and that this mismatch cannot be corrected in latent space because the VAE encoder is not scale-equivariant. Building on this analysis we introduce MACRO, Multi-plane Attention for Closeup Render Optimization, a training-free method for high-quality close-up novel view synthesis from 3DGS. MACRO resolves the scale gap by leveraging the scene's known 3D structure: it decomposes the close-up into depth planes, crops and resizes references in image space to match the scale of each plane before encoding, and applies a depth-aware attention mask so each token attends only to scale-matched references. The method requires no architectural changes or additional training. We further contribute two new close-up novel view synthesis benchmarks, the first standardized evaluation protocol for this setting, and demonstrate state-of-the-art results on both, outperforming existing 3DGS and diffusion-based methods on both reconstruction and perceptual metrics. Project page: https://nitzanhod.github.io/MACRO

AI.tldr: MACRO是一种无需训练的3DGS近景渲染优化方法，通过多平面深度分解和尺度匹配的参考图像注意力机制，解决了近景与参考视图之间的尺度差异问题，在近景新视角合成任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS在近景渲染时质量下降，扩散模型的参考条件增强方法因视图间尺度差异产生严重伪影，根本原因是VAE编码器的尺度不等变性导致跨视图注意力检索到错误的对应关系。
AI.method: 将近景按深度分解为多个平面，对每个平面从参考图像中裁剪并缩放以匹配尺度，再使用深度感知的注意力掩码，使每个token仅关注与其尺度匹配的参考图像。
AI.result: 在提出的两个近景新视角合成基准上，MACRO在重建和感知指标上均超越现有3DGS和扩散方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用场景已知的3D结构进行尺度对齐，无需架构修改或额外训练即可显著提升近景渲染质量。

title: Wan-Streamer v0.2: Higher Resolution, Same Latency
summary: We present Wan-Streamer v0.2, a latency-preserving upgrade of the native-streaming, end-to-end audio-visual interaction model. v0.2 keeps the v0.1 modeling formulation, but raises the interactive output stream from 192x336 to 640x368 while preserving approximately 200 ms model-side signal-to-signal latency at 25 FPS. The higher-resolution stream supports scene-grounded mid-shot agents whose posture, gaze, hands, nearby objects, and local scene layout remain legible during real-time conversation. To support the larger visual stream without adding user-visible delay, v0.2 keeps the thinker as a single-GPU low-latency path for streaming perception, the short language/state Transformer pass that builds the generation cache, and final decoding. The performer becomes a multi-GPU Ulysses-style context-parallel group for the expensive next-unit latent generation. Each performer rank writes incoming K/V into a pre-sharded local cache. The long high-resolution latent video sequence is split across ranks for denoising and gathered through Ulysses communication, while the much shorter audio latent sequence is generated without sequence sharding. In this split, the thinker's language/state computation reaches the performer only as K/V conditioning, so no separate language sequence has to be communicated inside the performer group. This concentrates additional hardware on visual generation while preserving the compact thinker-performer boundary, keeping total remote interaction latency at approximately 550 ms when a 350 ms bidirectional network budget is included.

AI.tldr: Wan-Streamer v0.2 是一个延迟保持的音视频交互模型升级版，将输出流分辨率从192x336提升至640x368，同时保持约200ms模型端延迟，通过将生成器拆分为单GPU思考者（流式感知、语言/状态处理）和多GPU表演者（上下文并行的潜在生成）来实现高分辨率流处理，总远程交互延迟约550ms（含网络预算）。
AI.motivation: 在不增加用户可感知延迟的前提下，提升实时音视频交互模型的输出流分辨率（从192x336到640x368），使场景中的中景智能体（姿态、目光、手部、附近物体及局部场景布局）在实时对话中保持可辨识度。
AI.method: 采用思考者-表演者（thinker-performer）分离架构：思考者为单GPU低延迟路径，负责流式感知、短语言/状态Transformer传递及生成缓存构建与最终解码；表演者为多GPU Ulysses风格上下文并行组，负责昂贵的下一单元潜在生成，将高分辨率潜在视频序列分片去噪并通过Ulysses通信聚合，音频潜在序列不分片，思考者仅以K/V条件化方式传递到表演者，避免单独的语言序列在表演者组内通信。
AI.result: 在保持约200ms模型端信号到信号延迟（25 FPS）的同时，将输出流分辨率从192x336提升至640x368；加上约350ms双向网络预算后，总远程交互延迟约为550ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过思考者-表演者分离架构，成功在保持低延迟的前提下显著提升分辨率，将额外的硬件资源集中在视觉生成上，同时保持紧凑的边界，为实时高分辨率音视频交互提供了可行的工程方案。

title: SGF-CDNet: A Consistency-Discrepancy Graph Network over Semantic-Geometric Fused Nodes for Face Forgery Detection
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. This work has been accepted at ICMEW 2026
summary: The rapid advancement of deepfakes necessitates robust face forgery detection. Although forged faces may lack obvious artifacts, they often contain subtle disharmony among different facial regions. We propose SGF-CDNet, a Consistency-Discrepancy Graph Network (CD-GNN) over Semantic-Geometric Fused (SGF) nodes. First, SGF-CDNet constructs SGF nodes by deeply fusing semantic regions from face parsing with geometric information from facial landmarks, allowing nodes to capture both high-level concepts and precise geometric constraints.
